    def _panel_rect_for_size(self, w, h):
        sm = _RoundedShadowFrame.SHADOW_MARGIN
        return QRect(sm, sm, max(100, w - 2 * sm), max(100, h - 2 * sm))

    def showEvent(self, event):
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._first_show_animated:
            self._first_show_animated = True
            animate_window_open(self, rise_px=12)

    def _show_settings(self):
        self._stop_anim()
        cur_geo = self.geometry()
        tw, th = self._settings_size
        # 以窗口中心对称平滑展开
        cx, cy = cur_geo.center().x(), cur_geo.center().y()
        target_geo = QRect(cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2, tw, th)

        # 面板从右侧微滑入 + 柔和淡入
        final_panel_rect = self._panel_rect_for_size(tw, th)
        start_panel_rect = QRect(final_panel_rect.x() + 42, final_panel_rect.y(),
                                 final_panel_rect.width(), final_panel_rect.height())
        self.settings_panel.setGeometry(start_panel_rect)
        self.settings_panel.show()
        self.settings_panel.raise_()
        if self.settings_panel._nav_indicator is not None:
            self.settings_panel._nav_indicator.sync_immediate()

        eff = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self.settings_panel)
        eff.setOpacity(0.0)
        self.settings_panel.setGraphicsEffect(eff)

        profile = current_motion_profile()
        dur = max(220, profile.tab_ms)
        ease = make_ease_out()

        group = QParallelAnimationGroup(self)

        win_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'geometry', group)
        win_anim.setDuration(dur)
        win_anim.setStartValue(cur_geo)
        win_anim.setEndValue(target_geo)
        win_anim.setEasingCurve(ease)

        slide_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self.settings_panel, b'geometry', group)
        slide_anim.setDuration(dur)
        slide_anim.setStartValue(start_panel_rect)
        slide_anim.setEndValue(final_panel_rect)
        slide_anim.setEasingCurve(ease)

        fade_anim = QPropertyAnimation(eff, b'opacity', group)
        fade_anim.setDuration(max(170, dur - 40))
        fade_anim.setStartValue(0.0)
        fade_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        fade_anim.setEasingCurve(ease)

        group.addAnimation(win_anim)
        group.addAnimation(slide_anim)
        group.addAnimation(fade_anim)

        def _done():
            self.settings_panel.setGraphicsEffect(None)
            self.settings_panel.setGeometry(self._panel_rect_for_size(self.width(), self.height()))
            if self.settings_panel._nav_indicator is not None:
                self.settings_panel._nav_indicator.sync_immediate()
            self.settings_panel.setFocus()

        group.finished.connect(_done)
        self._setting_anim = group
        group.start()

    def _hide_settings(self):
        self._stop_anim()
        cur_geo = self.geometry()
        tw, th = self._main_size
        cx, cy = cur_geo.center().x(), cur_geo.center().y()
        target_geo = QRect(cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2, tw, th)

        cur_panel_rect = self.settings_panel.geometry()
        end_panel_rect = QRect(cur_panel_rect.x() + 36, cur_panel_rect.y(),
                               cur_panel_rect.width(), cur_panel_rect.height())

        eff = QGraphicsOpacityEffect(self.settings_panel)
        eff.setOpacity(1.0)
        self.settings_panel.setGraphicsEffect(eff)

        profile = current_motion_profile()
        dur = max(180, profile.tab_ms - 50)
        ease = make_ease_out()

        group = QParallelAnimationGroup(self)

        win_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'geometry', group)
        win_anim.setDuration(dur + 15)
        win_anim.setStartValue(cur_geo)
        win_anim.setEndValue(target_geo)
        win_anim.setEasingCurve(ease)

        slide_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self.settings_panel, b'geometry', group)
        slide_anim.setDuration(max(150, dur - 20))
        slide_anim.setStartValue(cur_panel_rect)
        slide_anim.setEndValue(end_panel_rect)
        slide_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.InCubic)

        fade_anim = QPropertyAnimation(eff, b'opacity', group)
        fade_anim.setDuration(max(140, dur - 35))
        fade_anim.setStartValue(1.0)
        fade_anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        fade_anim.setEasingCurve(ease)

        group.addAnimation(win_anim)
        group.addAnimation(slide_anim)
        group.addAnimation(fade_anim)

        def _done():
            self.settings_panel.setGraphicsEffect(None)
            self.settings_panel.hide()
            self._refresh_model_latency_bar()

        group.finished.connect(_done)
        self._setting_anim = group
        group.start()

    def _stop_anim(self):
        """停止当前动画并清理"""
        if hasattr(self, '_setting_anim') and self._setting_anim is not None:
            try:
                self._setting_anim.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self._setting_anim.finished.disconnect()
            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
                pass
            self._setting_anim = None

    def _on_mode_selected(self, mode_key, animate=True):
        prev_mode = getattr(self, 'mode', None)
        self.mode = mode_key
        self.card_fullscreen.set_selected(mode_key == 'fullscreen', animate=animate)
        self.card_window.set_selected(mode_key == 'window', animate=animate)
        self.card_region.set_selected(mode_key == 'region', animate=animate)

        if mode_key == 'region':
            self.btn_reselect_region.show()
            self.btn_reselect_window.hide()
            self.sentence_cb.show()
            self.sentence_lbl.show()
            self.sentence_hint.show()
            if animate and self.isVisible() and prev_mode != 'region':
                for w in (self.btn_reselect_region, self.sentence_cb, self.sentence_lbl, self.sentence_hint):
                    animate_widget_fade_in(w, 170)
        elif mode_key == 'window':
            self.btn_reselect_region.hide()
            self.btn_reselect_window.show()
            self.sentence_cb.hide()
            self.sentence_lbl.hide()
            self.sentence_hint.hide()
            if animate and self.isVisible() and prev_mode != 'window':
                animate_widget_fade_in(self.btn_reselect_window, 170)
        else:
            self.btn_reselect_region.hide()
            self.btn_reselect_window.hide()
            self.sentence_cb.hide()
            self.sentence_lbl.hide()
            self.sentence_hint.hide()
        # 选取翻译：未选过时立即弹出；已选过时再次点卡片也允许重选
        if mode_key == 'region':
            if not self.region:
                self.pick_region()
        # 应用窗口翻译：未选过时立即弹出
        elif mode_key == 'window' and not self.target_hwnd:
            self.pick_window()

    def pick_region(self):
        self.hide()
        self.region_selector = RegionSelector()
        self.region_selector.region_selected.connect(self.on_region_selected)
        self.region_selector.show()

    def on_region_selected(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.region = (x, y, w, h)
        self.show()
        self.activateWindow()
        self.raise_()
        self.status_label.setText(tr('已选区域: {w}×{h}  点击「开始翻译」', w=w, h=h))

    def pick_window(self):
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QListWidget, QListWidgetItem
        windows = enum_visible_windows()
        if not windows:
            _show_message_box(self, QMessageBox.Information, tr('提示'), tr('未找到可用窗口'))
            return

        dlg = _WindowPickerDialog(parent=None, logo_icon=self.logo_icon)
        if self.testAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen):
            dlg.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen, True)
        dlg.setStyleSheet(FOXO_INPUT_QSS + '\n' + FOXO_TABLE_QSS)

        frame = FoxoRoundedWindowFrame(shadow_margin=18, border_radius=20)
        outer = QVBoxLayout(dlg)
        outer.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer.setSpacing(0)
        outer.addWidget(frame)

        sm = frame.SHADOW_MARGIN
        lay = QVBoxLayout(frame)
        lay.setContentsMargins(sm + 20, sm + 16, sm + 20, sm + 18)
        lay.setSpacing(10)

        header = build_foxo_title_bar(
            tr('选择应用窗口'),
            subtitle=tr('双击或选中要翻译的游戏窗口'),
            logo_icon=self.logo_icon_tight,
            on_close=dlg.reject,
            close_tooltip=tr('关闭'),
        )
        lay.addWidget(header)

        sep = QFrame()
        sep.setFixedHeight(1)
        sep.setStyleSheet('background: #EAE6E1;')
        lay.addWidget(sep)

        search = QLineEdit()
        search.setPlaceholderText(tr('输入关键词筛选窗口...'))
        lay.addWidget(search)

        lst = QListWidget()
        lst.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))
        attach_smooth_scroll(lst)
        lst_frame = RoundedTableFrame(lst)

        def _populate(keyword=''):
            lst.clear()
            kw = keyword.strip().lower()
            for hwnd, title in windows:
                if not kw or kw in title.lower():
                    item = QListWidgetItem(title)
                    item.setData(Qt.UserRole, hwnd)
                    lst.addItem(item)
            if lst.count() > 0:
                lst.setCurrentRow(0)

        _populate()
        search.textChanged.connect(_populate)
        lay.addWidget(lst_frame, 1)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_row.setSpacing(8)
        btn_cancel = AnimatedSecondaryButton(tr('取消'), variant='outline', radius=9)
        btn_cancel.setFont(ui_font(9.8, QFont.Medium))
        btn_cancel.setFixedHeight(36)
        btn_cancel.clicked.connect(dlg.reject)

        btn_ok = AnimatedPrimaryButton(tr('确定绑定'), variant='primary', radius=9)
        btn_ok.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Bold))
        btn_ok.setFixedHeight(36)
        btn_ok.clicked.connect(dlg.accept)
        lst.itemDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _it: dlg.accept())

        btn_row.addStretch()
        btn_row.addWidget(btn_cancel)
        btn_row.addWidget(btn_ok)
        lay.addLayout(btn_row)

        _center_dialog_on_parent(dlg, self)
        if dlg.exec() == QDialog.Accepted:
            cur = lst.currentItem()
            if cur is not None:
                self.target_hwnd = cur.data(Qt.UserRole)
                self.status_label.setText(tr('已绑定: {title}', title=cur.text()))

    def _is_in_drag_area(self, pos):
        """判断点击位置是否在可拖动区域（标题栏）

        可拖动区域：从窗口顶部到标题栏底部（不含设置按钮区域）。
        通过排除可交互控件（按钮、卡片、输入框）来避免误拖动。
        """
        # 获取点击位置的子控件
        child = self.childAt(pos)
        if child is None:
            # 点击在透明区域或 container 边距区，允许拖动
            return True
        # 排除交互控件：按钮、卡片、输入框、复选框、滑块
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
            QPushButton, QComboBox, QCheckBox, QSlider, QLineEdit,
            QRadioButton, QScrollArea, QScrollBar
        )
        # 向上查找：可能是嵌套在 QLabel 里的图标等，需要检查父控件
        current = child
        while current is not None and current is not self:
            if isinstance(current, (QPushButton, QComboBox, QCheckBox, QSlider,
                                    QLineEdit, QRadioButton, QScrollArea, QScrollBar,
                                    AnimatedModeCard, AnimatedPresetCard,
                                    AnimatedSegmentedControl, AnimatedToggleSwitch)):
                return False
            current = current.parentWidget() if hasattr(current, 'parentWidget') else None
        # 标题栏区域：logo + 标题 + 副标题（QLabel/QFrame）
        # 检查是否在标题栏 Y 范围内（顶部 ~80px 以内，含阴影边距）
        sm = 24  # SHADOW_MARGIN
        title_area_bottom = sm + 14 + 48 + 14  # 阴影 + 上边距 + logo高度 + 下间距
        if pos.y() <= title_area_bottom:
            return True
        # 其他非交互区域（如装饰分隔线、空白区）也允许拖动
        # 排除 ModeCard（可点击卡片）
        if isinstance(child, (ModeCard, AnimatedModeCard)):
            return False
        # QLabel 默认允许拖动（标题、副标题、装饰文字）
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QLabel, QFrame
        if isinstance(child, (QLabel, QFrame)):
            return True
        return False

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton and self._is_in_drag_area(event.position().toPoint()):
            anim = getattr(self, '_win_motion_anim', None)
            if anim is not None:
                try:
                    anim.stop()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._win_motion_anim = None
                self.setWindowOpacity(1.0)
            self._drag_pos = event.globalPosition() - self.frameGeometry().topLeft()
            event.accept()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
        if event.buttons() & Qt.LeftButton and self._drag_pos is not None:
            self.move((event.globalPosition() - self._drag_pos).toPoint())
            event.accept()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
        self._drag_pos = None

    def resizeEvent(self, event):
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        if self.settings_panel.isVisible() and not (
            hasattr(self, '_setting_anim') and self._setting_anim is not None
            and self._setting_anim.state() == QParallelAnimationGroup.Running
        ):
            self.settings_panel.setGeometry(self._panel_rect_for_size(self.width(), self.height()))

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_F6:
            self.toggle_translation()
        elif event.key() == Qt.Key_Escape:
            if self.settings_panel.isVisible():
                self._hide_settings()
            elif self.running:
                self.stop_translation()
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def init_tray(self):
        self.tray = QSystemTrayIcon(self.logo_icon, self)
        self.tray.setToolTip(tr('Foxo - 实时游戏原地翻译'))
        menu = FoxoTrayMenu(logo_icon=self.logo_icon_tight)
        self._tray_act_show = menu.add_item(
            'window', tr('显示主窗口'), self.restore_from_tray, tone='normal',
        )
        self._tray_act_toggle = menu.add_item(
            'play', tr('开始翻译'), self.toggle_translation, shortcut='F6', tone='accent',
        )
        self._tray_act_overlay = menu.add_item(
            'eye_off', tr('隐藏覆盖层'), self.toggle_overlay_visibility, shortcut='F7', tone='normal',
        )
        self._tray_act_refresh = menu.add_item(
            'refresh', tr('强制刷新画面'), self.force_refresh_translation, shortcut='F8', tone='normal',
        )
        menu.add_divider()
        self._tray_act_quit = menu.add_item(
            'quit', tr('退出'), self.close, tone='danger',
        )
        menu.aboutToShow.connect(self._sync_tray_menu_state)
        self._tray_menu = menu
        self._sync_tray_menu_state()
        self.tray.setContextMenu(menu)
        self.tray.activated.connect(self.restore_from_tray)
        self.tray.show()

    def _sync_tray_menu_state(self):
        if not hasattr(self, '_tray_menu') or self._tray_menu is None:
            return
        running = bool(getattr(self, 'running', False))
        ov = getattr(self, 'overlay', None)
        hidden = bool(running and ov is not None and ov.is_user_hidden())

        if not running:
            self._tray_menu.set_status('idle', tr('已停止'))
            self._tray_act_toggle.configure(
                icon_kind='play', text=tr('开始翻译'), tone='accent',
            )
        elif hidden:
            self._tray_menu.set_status('hidden', tr('已隐身'))
            self._tray_act_toggle.configure(
                icon_kind='stop', text=tr('停止翻译'), tone='danger_active',
            )
        else:
            self._tray_menu.set_status('running', tr('翻译中'))
            self._tray_act_toggle.configure(
                icon_kind='stop', text=tr('停止翻译'), tone='danger_active',
            )

        if hidden:
            self._tray_act_overlay.configure(
                icon_kind='eye', text=tr('显示覆盖层'), enabled=running,
            )
        else:
            self._tray_act_overlay.configure(
                icon_kind='eye_off', text=tr('隐藏覆盖层'), enabled=running,
            )
        self._tray_act_refresh.configure(enabled=running)

    def toggle_overlay_visibility(self):
        """F7 全局一键显示/隐藏覆盖层"""
        if not self.running:
            return
        new_hidden = not self.overlay.is_user_hidden()
        self.overlay.set_user_hidden(new_hidden)
        if not new_hidden:
            # 恢复显示后立刻刷新一次当前画面
            self.force_refresh_translation()

    def force_refresh_translation(self):
        """F8 立即强制刷新当前画面翻译（运行中抢占打断旧任务）"""
        if not self.running:
            return
        if self.overlay.is_user_hidden():
            self.overlay.set_user_hidden(False)
        self._last_frame_hash = None
        self._pending_change_frames = 0
        self._last_dispatch_ts = 0.0
        if self.worker and self.worker.isRunning():
            self._abort_active_worker()
        self.dispatch_worker(force_refresh=True)

    def toggle_translation(self):
        config['src_lang'] = 'ja'
        config['dest_lang'] = 'zh-CN'
        config['translation_source'] = self.settings_panel.current_provider
        save_config(config)
        self._refresh_model_latency_bar()

        if self.mode == 'window' and not self.target_hwnd:
            self.pick_window()
            if not self.target_hwnd:
                return
        if self.mode == 'region' and not self.region:
            self.pick_region()
            if not self.region:
                return

        if self.running:
            self.stop_translation()
        else:
            self.start_translation()

    def start_translation(self):
        if hasattr(self, 'settings_panel') and self.settings_panel.current_provider == 'ai':
            ai_cfg = config.get('ai') or {}
            warmup_ai_connection(ai_cfg.get('base_url', ''), ai_cfg.get('api_key', ''))
        self.running = True
        self.btn_toggle.setText(tr('停止翻译'))
        self.btn_toggle.set_variant('danger', animate=True)
        self.status_dot.set_state(True, '#10B981')
        self.status_label.setText(tr('准备中...'))
        if self.mode == 'fullscreen':
            self.overlay.set_fullscreen()
        self.hide()
        self.tray.showMessage(
            tr('Foxo'), tr('翻译已开始，设置窗口已隐藏\n右键托盘图标可恢复'),
            QSystemTrayIcon.Information, 3000
        )
        self._last_frame_hash = None
        self._pending_change_frames = 0  # 连续变化帧计数
        self._recheck_pending = False
        self._last_dispatch_ts = 0.0
        self._dispatch_started_at = None
        self._last_process_ms = 500  # 上次处理耗时估计，用于动态间隔

        self._base_interval = self._compute_base_interval()
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.check_and_dispatch)
        self.timer.start(self._base_interval)
        self.check_and_dispatch()

    def _compute_base_interval(self):
        if not config.get('dyn_interval', True):
            return 1000
        if self.mode in ('region', 'window'):
            raw = int(config.get('subtitle_interval_ms', 100))
        else:
            raw = int(config.get('fullscreen_interval_ms', 150))
        return max(60, min(400, raw))

    def _abort_active_worker(self):
        """安全断开并中止当前活动翻译线程，并交由 retiring 集合等待其自然退出"""
        w = self.worker
        if w is None:
            return
        self.worker = None
        for sig in (
            w.result_ready, w.batch_start, w.prune_stale, w.ai_latency,
            w.batch_done, w.finished_status, w.finished_error,
            w.overlay_geometry, w.progress, w.recheck_needed,
        ):
            try:
                sig.disconnect()
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            w.finished.disconnect(self._on_worker_finished)
        except Exception:
            pass
        w.abort()
        if w.isRunning():
            self._retiring_workers.add(w)
        else:
            w.deleteLater()

    def stop_translation(self):
        self.running = False
        self.btn_toggle.setText(tr('开始翻译'))
        self.btn_toggle.set_variant('primary', animate=True)
        self.status_dot.set_state(False)
        self.status_label.setText(tr('已停止'))
        if hasattr(self, 'timer'):
            self.timer.stop()
        self._abort_active_worker()
        # 重置去重状态，避免下次启动时误判为"内容无变化"
        reset_dedup_state()
        self.overlay.hide_overlay()
        self.show()
        self.activateWindow()
        self.raise_()

    def _cleanup_worker(self, w):
        self._retiring_workers.discard(w)
        if self.worker is w:
            self.worker = None
        try:
            w.deleteLater()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def dispatch_worker(self, force_refresh=False, initial_frame=None):
        if self.worker and self.worker.isRunning():
            return
        self._recheck_pending = False
        provider = self.settings_panel.current_provider
        worker = TranslationWorker(
            'ja', 'zh-CN', mode=self.mode,
            target_hwnd=self.target_hwnd,
            region=self.region, provider=provider,
            force_refresh=force_refresh,
            initial_frame=initial_frame,
        )
        self.worker = worker
        worker.result_ready.connect(self.on_result_ready)
        worker.batch_start.connect(self.on_batch_start)
        worker.prune_stale.connect(self.on_prune_stale)
        worker.ai_latency.connect(self.on_ai_latency)
        worker.batch_done.connect(self.on_batch_done)
        worker.finished_status.connect(self.on_status)
        worker.finished_error.connect(self.on_error)
        worker.overlay_geometry.connect(self.on_overlay_geometry)
        worker.progress.connect(self.on_progress)
        worker.recheck_needed.connect(self.on_recheck_needed)
        worker.finished.connect(self._on_worker_finished)
        worker.finished.connect(lambda w=worker: self._cleanup_worker(w))
        worker.start()

    def on_overlay_geometry(self, x, y, w, h):
        self.overlay.set_geometry(x, y, w, h)

    def on_batch_start(self, count):
        self.overlay.begin_batch(count)

    def on_prune_stale(self, keep_boxes=None):
        self.overlay.prune_stale(keep_boxes)

    def on_recheck_needed(self):
        self._last_frame_hash = None
        self._pending_change_frames = 0
        self._last_dispatch_ts = 0.0
        self._recheck_pending = True

    def _on_worker_finished(self):
        if self.worker is not None and self.worker.isRunning():
            return
        if self._recheck_pending and self.running and not self.overlay.is_user_hidden():
            self._recheck_pending = False
            self._last_dispatch_ts = 0.0
            if hasattr(self, 'timer') and self.timer is not None:
                try:
                    self.timer.setInterval(self._base_interval)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            QTimer.singleShot(15, self.check_and_dispatch)
        elif (self.running and config.get('dyn_interval', True)
              and hasattr(self, 'timer') and self.timer is not None
              and get_stable_text_frames() >= 3):
            try:
                stable_ms = max(300, min(1000, int(config.get('stable_interval_ms', 550))))
                if self.mode in ('region', 'window'):
                    self.timer.setInterval(min(stable_ms, 220))
                else:
                    # 全屏保持高频帧哈希检测以便切页零延迟响应，仅小幅波动走稳定期冷却限频
                    self.timer.setInterval(self._base_interval)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def on_result_ready(self, box, translated, style_info=None):
        self.overlay.add_result(box, translated, style_info=style_info)

    def check_and_dispatch(self):
        if not self.running:
            return
        if self.overlay.is_user_hidden():
            return
        if self.worker and self.worker.isRunning():
            return

        import time
        initial_frame = None
        is_subtitle_mode = self.mode in ('region', 'window')

        if self.mode == 'window' and self.target_hwnd:
            if not is_window_valid(self.target_hwnd):
                self.overlay.clear_labels()
                reset_dedup_state()
                return
            _x, _y, w, h = get_window_rect(self.target_hwnd)
            if w <= 0 or h <= 0:
                self.overlay.clear_labels()
                reset_dedup_state()
                return

        if not is_subtitle_mode and config.get('frame_hash', True):
            img = None
            if (_DXGI_AVAILABLE and _capture_fullscreen_dxgi is not None
                    and config.get('capture_engine', 'dxgi') == 'dxgi'):
                try:
                    img = _capture_fullscreen_dxgi()
                except Exception:
                    img = None
            if img is None:
                try:
                    img = capture_fullscreen()
                except Exception:
                    return
            cur_hash = frame_hash(img)
            if self._last_frame_hash is not None:
                dist = frame_hash_distance(cur_hash, self._last_frame_hash)
                local_dist = frame_hash_local_distance(cur_hash, self._last_frame_hash)
                frame_thresh = int(config.get('frame_hash_threshold', 4))
                local_thresh = max(frame_thresh + 2, 6)
                if dist < frame_thresh and local_dist < local_thresh:
                    self._pending_change_frames = 0
                    return
                # 页面关闭/切页/局部面板切换直接跳过确认帧与稳定期冷却，零延迟响应
                scene_change_thresh = max(frame_thresh * 3, 12)
                local_scene_thresh = max(frame_thresh * 4, 18)
                if dist >= scene_change_thresh or local_dist >= local_scene_thresh:
                    self._pending_change_frames = 0
                else:
                    if config.get('dyn_interval', True) and get_stable_text_frames() >= 3:
                        stable_ms = max(300, min(1000, int(config.get('stable_interval_ms', 550))))
                        if (time.monotonic() - getattr(self, '_last_dispatch_ts', 0.0)) * 1000.0 < stable_ms:
                            return
                    confirm_frames = int(config.get('frame_confirm_frames', 1))
                    self._pending_change_frames += 1
                    if self._pending_change_frames < confirm_frames:
                        # 保持 _last_frame_hash 指向“上次已派发翻译的帧”，禁止在此覆盖导致单帧切页被吞掉
                        return
            self._last_frame_hash = cur_hash
            self._pending_change_frames = 0
            initial_frame = img

        # 记录开始时间，用于动态间隔与稳定期冷却调整
        self._last_dispatch_ts = time.monotonic()
        self._dispatch_started_at = time.time()
        self.dispatch_worker(initial_frame=initial_frame)

    def _update_interval(self, process_ms):
        """根据基础检测间隔与单次处理耗时动态调整轮询频率"""
        if not config.get('dyn_interval', True):
            return
        if self.mode in ('region', 'window'):
            base = int(config.get('subtitle_interval_ms', 100))
        else:
            base = int(config.get('fullscreen_interval_ms', 150))
        min_int = max(60, int(round(base * 0.75)))
        max_int = min(420, int(round(base * 1.5)))
        target = max(min_int, min(max_int, int(process_ms * 0.08 + min_int)))
        if hasattr(self, 'timer') and self.timer is not None:
            try:
                self.timer.setInterval(target)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def on_batch_done(self):
        self.overlay.finish_batch()
        # 计算本次处理耗时，更新动态间隔
        import time
        if getattr(self, '_dispatch_started_at', None) is not None:
            process_ms = (time.time() - self._dispatch_started_at) * 1000
            self._last_process_ms = process_ms
            self._update_interval(process_ms)

    def on_progress(self, done, total):
        if self.running and total > 0:
            pct = int(done * 100 / total)
            self.status_label.setText(tr('翻译进度 {done}/{total} ({pct}%)', done=done, total=total, pct=pct))

    def _current_model_display(self):
        provider = self.settings_panel.current_provider if hasattr(self, 'settings_panel') else config.get('translation_source', 'ai')
        if provider == 'ai':
            model = ((config.get('ai') or {}).get('model', '') or '').strip()
            return model or 'AI', tr('模型 {name}', name=model or 'AI')
        p_info = PROVIDERS.get(provider, {})
        p_name = p_info.get('name', provider)
        return provider, tr('翻译源 {name}', name=p_name)

    def _refresh_model_latency_bar(self):
        if not hasattr(self, 'model_info_label') or not hasattr(self, 'ttft_label'):
            return
        model_id, display_txt = self._current_model_display()
        self.model_info_label.setText(display_txt)

        if self._last_ttft_ms is None:
            latest = get_last_ai_latency()
            if latest.get('ttft_ms') is not None and latest.get('model') == model_id:
                self._last_latency_model = model_id
                self._last_ttft_ms = int(latest['ttft_ms'])

        if self._last_latency_model != model_id or self._last_ttft_ms is None:
            self._last_latency_model = model_id
            self._last_ttft_ms = None
            self.ttft_label.setText(tr('首字延迟 --'))
            self.ttft_label.setStyleSheet('color: #78716C; background: transparent;')
            return

        ms = int(self._last_ttft_ms)
        val_txt = f'{ms}ms' if ms < 1000 else f'{ms / 1000.0:.2f}s'
        is_ai = (self.settings_panel.current_provider if hasattr(self, 'settings_panel') else config.get('translation_source', 'ai')) == 'ai'
        lbl_text = tr('首字延迟 {val}', val=val_txt) if is_ai else tr('响应延迟 {val}', val=val_txt)
        if ms < 1000:
            color = '#059669'
        elif ms <= 2500:
            color = '#DC7B45'
        else:
            color = '#D94B4B'
        self.ttft_label.setText(lbl_text)
        self.ttft_label.setStyleSheet(f'color: {color}; background: transparent;')

    def on_ai_latency(self, model, ttft_ms, total_ms=0):
        self._last_latency_model = str(model or '')
        self._last_ttft_ms = max(0, int(ttft_ms))
        self._refresh_model_latency_bar()

    def on_status(self, msg):
        self.status_label.setText(msg)

    def on_error(self, err):
        import time
        msg = str(err or '')
        self.status_label.setText(tr('错误: {err}', err=msg))
        if (self.running and not self.isVisible()
                and hasattr(self, 'tray') and self.tray is not None):
            last_msg, last_ts = getattr(self, '_last_error_toast', ('', 0.0))
            now = time.monotonic()
            if msg != last_msg or (now - last_ts) >= 15.0:
                self._last_error_toast = (msg, now)
                self.tray.showMessage(
                    tr('Foxo 翻译失败'), msg[:160],
                    QSystemTrayIcon.Warning, 5000,
                )

    def minimize_to_tray(self):
        def _after():
            self.tray.showMessage(tr('Foxo'), tr('已最小化到托盘'),
                                  QSystemTrayIcon.Information, 2000)
        animate_window_hide(self, drop_px=10, on_finished=_after)

    def restore_from_tray(self, reason=None):
        if reason == QSystemTrayIcon.Context:
            return
        self.showNormal()
        self.activateWindow()
        self.raise_()
        animate_window_open(self, rise_px=10)

    def _maybe_auto_check_update(self):
        if getattr(self, '_closing', False):
            return
        if not config.get('auto_check_update', True):
            return
        if not get_github_repo():
            return
        if hasattr(self, 'settings_panel') and self.settings_panel is not None:
            self.settings_panel.start_update_check(manual=False)

    def _on_background_update_noticed(self, info):
        if getattr(self, '_closing', False) or info is None or not getattr(info, 'has_update', False):
            return
        if not self.isVisible() and hasattr(self, 'tray') and self.tray is not None:
            self.tray.showMessage(
                tr('发现 Foxo 新版本 v{ver}', ver=info.latest_version),
                tr('点击托盘图标打开主窗口，在设置「关于」页可查看更新公告并一键自动更新。'),
                QSystemTrayIcon.Information,
                5000,
            )

    def _on_apply_update_and_quit(self, bat_path):
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
        try:
            launch_update_script(bat_path)
        except Exception as e:
            _show_message_box(
                self,
                QMessageBox.Warning,
                tr('自动更新失败'),
                tr('下载或应用更新时出错：{err}', err=str(e)),
                QMessageBox.Ok,
                QMessageBox.Ok,
            )
            return
        self.close()
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is not None:
            app.quit()

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
        self._closing = True
        if hasattr(self, '_auto_update_timer') and self._auto_update_timer is not None:
            self._auto_update_timer.stop()
        if hasattr(self, '_hotkey_mgr') and self._hotkey_mgr is not None:
            self._hotkey_mgr.unregister_all(QApplication.instance())
        self.stop_translation()
        for w in list(self._retiring_workers):
            try:
                if w.isRunning():
                    w.abort()
                    w.wait(2000)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._retiring_workers.clear()
        if hasattr(self, 'settings_panel') and self.settings_panel is not None:
            self.settings_panel.wait_threads(2000)
        try:
            from foxo.dxgi_capture import release_camera
            release_camera()
        except Exception:
            pass
        save_config(config)
        if hasattr(self, '_tray_menu') and self._tray_menu is not None:
            self._tray_menu.close()
        self.tray.hide()
        self.overlay.close()
        translate_pool.shutdown(wait=False)
        event.accept()

```

`foxo/ui/welcome_wizard.py`:

class _AnimatedStepProgressBar(QWidget):
    """平滑填充步骤进度段（支持 60fps 弹性宽度推进）"""

    def __init__(self, filled: bool = False, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFixedHeight(5)
        self._filled = bool(filled)
        self._fill_p = 1.0 if filled else 0.0
        self._anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'fillProgress', self)
        self._anim.setDuration(240)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutQuart)

    def _get_fp(self):
        return self._fill_p

    def _set_fp(self, v):
        self._fill_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    fillProgress = Property(float, _get_fp, _set_fp)

    def set_filled(self, filled: bool, animate: bool = True):
        filled = bool(filled)
        if self._filled == filled and self._anim.state() != QPropertyAnimation.Running:
            return
        self._filled = filled
        target = 1.0 if filled else 0.0
        if not animate or not self.isVisible():
            self._anim.stop()
            self._fill_p = target
            self.update()
            return
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setDuration(profile.selection_ms)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._fill_p)
        self._anim.setEndValue(target)
        self._anim.start()

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        w, h = float(self.width()), float(self.height())
        r = h / 2.0
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor('#EAE6E1')))
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(0.0, 0.0, w, h), r, r)
        if self._fill_p > 0.01:
            fw = max(h, w * min(1.0, self._fill_p))
            lg = QLinearGradient(0.0, 0.0, fw, 0.0)
            lg.setColorAt(0.0, QColor('#E8925E'))
            lg.setColorAt(1.0, QColor('#DC7B45'))
            p.setBrush(QBrush(lg))
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(0.0, 0.0, fw, h), r, r)
        p.end()


class _OptionCard(QFrame):
    """可点击的选项卡片：60fps QPainter 悬停/按压/选中动效 + 图标 + 标题 + 描述"""
    clicked = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, icon, title, desc, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._selected = False
        self._hover_p = 0.0
        self._select_p = 0.0
        self._press_p = 0.0

        self.setFixedHeight(80)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setObjectName('optionCard')
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)

        self._hover_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'hoverProgress', self)
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(160)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self._select_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'selectProgress', self)
        self._select_anim.setDuration(220)
        self._select_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutQuart)

        self._press_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'pressProgress', self)
        self._press_anim.setDuration(105)
        self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        lay = QHBoxLayout(self)
        lay.setContentsMargins(16, 12, 46, 12)
        lay.setSpacing(14)

        if icon is not None:
            icon_lbl = QLabel()
            icon_lbl.setPixmap(icon.pixmap(40, 40))
            icon_lbl.setFixedSize(40, 40)
            icon_lbl.setStyleSheet('background: transparent;')
            lay.addWidget(icon_lbl)

        txt = QVBoxLayout()
        txt.setSpacing(2)
        self.title_lbl = QLabel(title)
        self.title_lbl.setFont(ui_font(11.5, QFont.Bold))
        self.title_lbl.setStyleSheet('color: #0F172A; background: transparent;')
        txt.addWidget(self.title_lbl)

        self.desc_lbl = QLabel(desc)
        self.desc_lbl.setFont(ui_font(9.5, QFont.Medium))
        self.desc_lbl.setStyleSheet('color: #78716C; background: transparent;')
        self.desc_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        txt.addWidget(self.desc_lbl)
        lay.addLayout(txt, 1)

    def _get_hp(self):
        return self._hover_p

    def _set_hp(self, v):
        self._hover_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    hoverProgress = Property(float, _get_hp, _set_hp)

    def _get_sp(self):
        return self._select_p

    def _set_sp(self, v):
        self._select_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    selectProgress = Property(float, _get_sp, _set_sp)

    def _get_pp(self):
        return self._press_p

    def _set_pp(self, v):
        self._press_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    pressProgress = Property(float, _get_pp, _set_pp)

    def set_selected(self, selected, animate=True):
        selected = bool(selected)
        if not animate or not self.isVisible():
            self._selected = selected
            self._select_anim.stop()
            self._select_p = 1.0 if selected else 0.0
            self.update()
            return
        if self._selected == selected and self._select_anim.state() != QPropertyAnimation.Running:
            return
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._selected = selected
        self._select_anim.stop()
        self._select_anim.setDuration(profile.selection_ms)
        self._select_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._select_anim.setStartValue(self._select_p)
        self._select_anim.setEndValue(1.0 if selected else 0.0)
        self._select_anim.start()

    def is_selected(self):
        return self._selected

    def enterEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._hover_anim.stop()
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(profile.hover_ms)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._hover_anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._hover_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._hover_anim.start()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._hover_anim.stop()
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(profile.return_ms)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._hover_anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._hover_anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._hover_anim.start()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            profile = current_motion_profile()
            self._press_anim.stop()
            self._press_anim.setDuration(profile.press_ms)
            self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(make_press_ease())
            self._press_anim.setStartValue(self._press_p)
            self._press_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
            self._press_anim.start()
            self.clicked.emit(self)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._press_anim.stop()
        self._press_anim.setDuration(profile.return_ms)
        self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._press_anim.setStartValue(self._press_p)
        self._press_anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._press_anim.start()
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    @staticmethod
    def _lerp(c1: QColor, c2: QColor, t: float) -> QColor:
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(t)))
        return QColor(
            int(c1.red() + (c2.red() - c1.red()) * t),
            int(c1.green() + (c2.green() - c1.green()) * t),
            int(c1.blue() + (c2.blue() - c1.blue()) * t),
            int(c1.alpha() + (c2.alpha() - c1.alpha()) * t),
        )

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        w, h = float(self.width()), float(self.height())
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        press_p = max(0.0, self._press_p)
        scale = min(1.0, 1.0 + (profile.pressed_scale - 1.0) * press_p)
        lift = profile.hover_lift * 0.6 * self._hover_p + profile.press_offset * press_p

        p.save()
        p.translate(w / 2.0, h / 2.0)
        p.scale(scale, scale)
        p.translate(-w / 2.0, -h / 2.0)

        rect = QRectF(4.0, 4.0 + lift, w - 8.0, h - 8.0)
        bg_l = self._lerp(self._lerp(QColor('#FFFFFF'), QColor('#FDFCFB'), self._hover_p), QColor('#FFFAF5'), self._select_p)
        bg_r = self._lerp(self._lerp(QColor('#FFFFFF'), QColor('#F9F7F4'), self._hover_p), QColor('#FDF5EE'), self._select_p)
        lg = QLinearGradient(rect.topLeft(), rect.topRight())
        lg.setColorAt(0.0, bg_l)
        lg.setColorAt(1.0, bg_r)

        bdr = self._lerp(self._lerp(QColor('#EAE6E1'), QColor('#F1C6A5'), self._hover_p), QColor('#DC7B45'), self._select_p)
        p.setBrush(QBrush(lg))
        p.setPen(QPen(bdr, 1.1 + 0.7 * self._select_p))
        p.drawRoundedRect(rect, 12.0, 12.0)

        if self._select_p > 0.03:
            bar_h = min(22.0, (h - 16.0) * self._select_p)
            p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
            p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(220, 123, 69, int(235 * self._select_p))))
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(rect.left() + 4.5, rect.center().y() - bar_h / 2.0, 3.0, bar_h), 1.5, 1.5)

        chk_cx, chk_cy = rect.right() - 22.0, rect.center().y()
        chk_r = 9.0
        if self._select_p > 0.05:
            p.setPen(QPen(self._lerp(QColor('#DDD7D0'), QColor('#DC7B45'), self._select_p), 1.5))
            p.setBrush(QBrush(self._lerp(QColor('#FFFFFF'), QColor('#DC7B45'), self._select_p)))
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(chk_cx, chk_cy), chk_r, chk_r)
            tick_p = (self._select_p - 0.25) / 0.75
            if tick_p > 0.02:
                draw_animated_checkmark(p, chk_cx, chk_cy, 0.95, tick_p, QColor(255, 255, 255, 255), 1.8)
        else:
            p.setPen(QPen(self._lerp(QColor('#DDD7D0'), QColor('#F1C6A5'), self._hover_p), 1.5))
            p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor('#FFFFFF')))
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(chk_cx, chk_cy), chk_r, chk_r)
        p.restore()
        p.end()


class WelcomeWizard(QDialog):
    """首次启动引导：语言 → 翻译源

    完成后通过 QApplication.exit(RESTART_EXIT_CODE) 触发应用重启，
    确保语言切换等配置在全新进程中生效。
    """

    # 自定义退出码：表示需要重启应用
    RESTART_EXIT_CODE = 1001

    completed = Signal()  # 用户完成引导后发出

    SHADOW_MARGIN = 16
    WIZARD_INNER_WIDTH = 620
    WIZARD_INNER_HEIGHT = 696
    WIZARD_WIDTH = WIZARD_INNER_WIDTH + SHADOW_MARGIN * 2
    WIZARD_HEIGHT = WIZARD_INNER_HEIGHT + SHADOW_MARGIN * 2

    def __init__(self, parent=None, is_reset=False):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowFlags(Qt.Window | Qt.FramelessWindowHint | Qt.WindowStaysOnTopHint)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_NoSystemBackground, True)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_OpaquePaintEvent, False)
        self.setWindowIcon(load_logo_icon_tight(64))
        self.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))
        # 设置窗口标题，避免默认显示 "python"
        self.setWindowTitle(tr('初始化设置'))

        self._is_reset = is_reset
        self._drag_pos = None
        self._first_show_animated = False
        self._current_step = 0
        self._lang_choice = get_language()
        self._provider_choice = config.get('translation_source', 'ai')
        self._cascade = CascadeEntranceController(self)

        self._init_ui()
        self._retranslate()
        # 关键：在 _init_ui 完成后再设固定尺寸，确保所有子控件
        # 的 sizeHint 已计算完毕，不会覆盖固定尺寸约束
        self.setFixedSize(self.WIZARD_WIDTH, self.WIZARD_HEIGHT)
        self._center_on_screen()

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setCompositionMode(QPainter.CompositionMode_Clear)
        p.fillRect(self.rect(), QBrush(QColor(0, 0, 0, 0)))
        p.end()

    def showEvent(self, event):
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._first_show_animated:
            self._first_show_animated = True
            animate_window_open(self, rise_px=12)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton and is_window_drag_target(
            self, event.position().toPoint(), extra_excluded=(_OptionCard,)
        ):
            anim = getattr(self, '_win_motion_anim', None)
            if anim is not None:
                try:
                    anim.stop()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._win_motion_anim = None
                self.setWindowOpacity(1.0)
            self._drag_pos = event.globalPosition() - self.frameGeometry().topLeft()
            event.accept()

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
        if event.buttons() & Qt.LeftButton and self._drag_pos is not None:
            self.move((event.globalPosition() - self._drag_pos).toPoint())
            event.accept()

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
        self._drag_pos = None

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):
        if event.key() == Qt.Key_Escape:
            self.reject()
            event.accept()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def sizeHint(self):
        """重写：锁定 sizeHint，防止 QStackedWidget 切换页面时
        因子控件 sizeHint 变化导致对话框大小抖动"""
        from PySide6.QtCore import QSize
        return QSize(self.WIZARD_WIDTH, self.WIZARD_HEIGHT)

    def minimumSizeHint(self):
        """重写：锁定 minimumSizeHint，与 sizeHint 保持一致"""
        from PySide6.QtCore import QSize
        return QSize(self.WIZARD_WIDTH, self.WIZARD_HEIGHT)

    def _center_on_screen(self):
        """将对话框居中到屏幕中央"""
        try:
            screen = self.screen().availableGeometry()
        except Exception:
            from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
            screen = QGuiApplication.primaryScreen().availableGeometry()
        self.move(
            screen.center().x() - self.width() // 2,
            screen.center().y() - self.height() // 2
        )

    # ============================================================
    # UI 构建
    # ============================================================

    def _init_ui(self):
        self.setStyleSheet('''
            QDialog { background: transparent; }
            QLabel { background: transparent; color: #0F172A; }
        ''')

        outer = QVBoxLayout(self)
        outer.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        outer.setSpacing(0)
        # 关键：使用 SetFixedSize 约束，禁止 layout 根据子控件的
        # sizeHint 变化而调整对话框大小
        outer.setSizeConstraint(QLayout.SetFixedSize)

        self._container = FoxoRoundedWindowFrame(shadow_margin=self.SHADOW_MARGIN, border_radius=20)
        outer.addWidget(self._container)

        sm = self._container.SHADOW_MARGIN
        inner = QVBoxLayout(self._container)
        inner.setContentsMargins(sm + 1, sm + 1, sm + 1, sm + 1)
        inner.setSpacing(0)

        # ===== 标题区（温润暖白圆角顶栏 + 底部细线 + 右上角关闭按钮） =====
        header = QFrame()
        header.setObjectName('wizardHeader')
        header.setFixedHeight(92)
        header.setStyleSheet('''
            QFrame#wizardHeader {
                background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:1,
                    stop:0 #FFFFFF, stop:1 #FFFAF5);
                border: none;
                border-top-left-radius: 19px;
                border-top-right-radius: 19px;
                border-bottom: 1px solid #EAE6E1;
            }
        ''')
        h_lay = QHBoxLayout(header)
        h_lay.setContentsMargins(32, 16, 20, 14)
        h_lay.setSpacing(14)

        logo_lbl = QLabel()
        logo_lbl.setPixmap(load_logo_icon_tight(48).pixmap(48, 48))
        logo_lbl.setFixedSize(48, 48)
        h_lay.addWidget(logo_lbl)

        title_col = QVBoxLayout()
        title_col.setSpacing(3)
        self.title_main = QLabel()
        self.title_main.setFont(ui_font(17.5, QFont.Bold))
        self.title_main.setStyleSheet('color: #0F172A; background: transparent;')
        title_col.addWidget(self.title_main)

        self.title_sub = QLabel()
        self.title_sub.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))
        self.title_sub.setStyleSheet('color: #78716C; background: transparent;')
        title_col.addWidget(self.title_sub)
        h_lay.addLayout(title_col, 1)

        close_btn = IconGhostButton('close', tr('关闭'))
        close_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        h_lay.addWidget(close_btn, 0, Qt.AlignTop)
        inner.addWidget(header)

        # ===== 步骤指示器（精致狐橙平滑填充胶囊进度段） =====
        self._step_indicators = []
        step_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        step_bar.setContentsMargins(32, 12, 32, 4)
        step_bar.setSpacing(8)
        for i in range(2):
            seg = _AnimatedStepProgressBar(filled=(i == 0))
            self._step_indicators.append(seg)
            step_bar.addWidget(seg, 1)
        inner.addLayout(step_bar)

        # ===== 内容区（QStackedWidget） =====
        # 关键：给 QStackedWidget 设固定最小/最大宽度，避免切换页面时
        # 因子页面宽度 sizeHint 不同导致窗口宽度抖动
        content_width = self.WIZARD_INNER_WIDTH - 2
        self._stack = QStackedWidget()
        self._stack.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Expanding)
        self._stack.setMinimumWidth(content_width)
        self._stack.setMaximumWidth(content_width)
        inner.addWidget(self._stack, 1)

        # 两个步骤页面
        self._page_lang = self._build_lang_page()
        self._page_provider = self._build_provider_page()
        # 给所有页面设置相同的固定宽度 + sizePolicy，避免宽度 sizeHint 差异
        for page in (self._page_lang, self._page_provider):
            page.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Expanding)
            page.setMinimumWidth(content_width)
            page.setMaximumWidth(content_width)
        self._stack.addWidget(self._page_lang)
        self._stack.addWidget(self._page_provider)

        # ===== 按钮区 =====
        btn_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        btn_bar.setContentsMargins(32, 6, 32, 18)
        btn_bar.setSpacing(12)

        self._btn_back = AnimatedSecondaryButton('', variant='outline', radius=10)
        self._btn_back.setFont(ui_font(10.5, QFont.Medium))
        self._btn_back.setFixedHeight(42)
        self._btn_back.setMinimumWidth(108)
        self._btn_back.clicked.connect(self._go_back)
        btn_bar.addWidget(self._btn_back)

        btn_bar.addStretch()

        self._btn_skip = AnimatedSecondaryButton('', variant='ghost', radius=10)
        self._btn_skip.setFont(ui_font(10.5, QFont.Medium))
        self._btn_skip.setFixedHeight(42)
        self._btn_skip.clicked.connect(self._finish)
        btn_bar.addWidget(self._btn_skip)

        self._btn_next = AnimatedPrimaryButton('', variant='primary', radius=10)
        self._btn_next.setFont(ui_font(10.5, QFont.Bold))
        self._btn_next.setFixedHeight(42)
        self._btn_next.setMinimumWidth(122)
        self._btn_next.clicked.connect(self._go_next)
        btn_bar.addWidget(self._btn_next)

        inner.addLayout(btn_bar)

        self._update_step()

    def _build_lang_page(self):
        page = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(page)
        lay.setContentsMargins(32, 8, 32, 12)
        lay.setSpacing(10)

        self._lang_step_title = QLabel()
        self._lang_step_title.setFont(ui_font(14.0, QFont.Bold))
        self._lang_step_title.setStyleSheet('color: #0F172A;')
        lay.addWidget(self._lang_step_title)

        self._lang_step_desc = QLabel()
        self._lang_step_desc.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))
        self._lang_step_desc.setStyleSheet('color: #78716C;')
        lay.addWidget(self._lang_step_desc)
        lay.addSpacing(6)

        self._lang_cards = {}
        for lang_code, lang_name in SUPPORTED_LANGS.items():
            card = _OptionCard(
                icon=None,
                title=lang_name,
                desc={'zh': '软件界面将使用此语言', 'en': 'Interface will use this language'}[lang_code],
            )
            card.setProperty('lang_code', lang_code)
            card.clicked.connect(lambda c, cards=self._lang_cards: self._select_exclusive(c, cards))
            lay.addWidget(card)
            self._lang_cards[lang_code] = card
            if lang_code == self._lang_choice:
                card.set_selected(True)

        lay.addStretch()
        return page

    def _build_provider_page(self):
        page = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(page)
        lay.setContentsMargins(32, 4, 32, 6)
        lay.setSpacing(6)

        self._prov_step_title = QLabel()
        self._prov_step_title.setFont(ui_font(14.0, QFont.Bold))
        self._prov_step_title.setStyleSheet('color: #0F172A;')
        lay.addWidget(self._prov_step_title)

        self._prov_step_desc = QLabel()
        self._prov_step_desc.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))
        self._prov_step_desc.setStyleSheet('color: #78716C;')
        self._prov_step_desc.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self._prov_step_desc)
        lay.addSpacing(2)

        # 加载翻译源图标
        from foxo.ui.settings_window import _load_provider_icon

        self._prov_cards = {}
        for key in _PROVIDER_ORDER:
            if key not in PROVIDERS:
                continue
            info = PROVIDERS[key]
            desc = _PROVIDER_DESC.get(key, {}).get(self._lang_choice, info.get('desc', ''))
            icon = _load_provider_icon(key, 40)
            card = _OptionCard(icon=icon, title=info['name'], desc=desc)
            card.setProperty('provider_key', key)
            card.clicked.connect(lambda c, cards=self._prov_cards: self._select_exclusive(c, cards))
            lay.addWidget(card)
            self._prov_cards[key] = card
            if key == self._provider_choice:
                card.set_selected(True)

        lay.addStretch()
        return page

    # ============================================================
    # 卡片互斥选中
    # ============================================================

    def _select_exclusive(self, clicked_card, cards_dict):
        """点击某个卡片时，取消同组其他卡片的选中状态"""
        for card in cards_dict.values():
            card.set_selected(card is clicked_card)

    # ============================================================
    # 多语言：刷新所有可见文本
    # ============================================================

    def _retranslate(self):
        """根据当前语言刷新所有文本（语言切换后调用）"""
        # 窗口标题
        self.setWindowTitle(tr('初始化设置'))
        # 标题区
        if self._is_reset:
            self.title_main.setText(tr('初始化设置'))
            self.title_sub.setText(tr('重新进行初始设置'))
        else:
            self.title_main.setText(f"{tr('欢迎使用')} Foxo")
            self.title_sub.setText(tr('首次使用请完成简单设置（约 30 秒）'))

        # 步骤 1：语言
        self._lang_step_title.setText(tr('选择软件界面语言'))
        self._lang_step_desc.setText(tr('稍后可在设置中修改'))

        # 步骤 2：翻译源
        self._prov_step_title.setText(tr('选择默认翻译源'))
        self._prov_step_desc.setText(tr('稍后可在设置中修改'))
        # 刷新翻译源卡片描述
        for key, card in self._prov_cards.items():
            desc = _PROVIDER_DESC.get(key, {}).get(self._lang_choice, '')
            card.desc_lbl.setText(desc)

        # 按钮
        self._btn_back.setText(tr('上一步'))
        self._btn_skip.setText(tr('跳过'))
        self._btn_next.setText(tr('下一步'))

        self._update_step()

    # ============================================================
    # 步骤切换逻辑
    # ============================================================

    def _update_step(self):
        """刷新步骤指示器、按钮状态并触发当前页卡片级联入场"""
        animate = self.isVisible()
        for i, seg in enumerate(self._step_indicators):
            seg.set_filled(i <= self._current_step, animate=animate)

        # 切换页面
        prev_idx = self._stack.currentIndex()
        self._stack.setCurrentIndex(self._current_step)

        # 按钮状态
        self._btn_back.setEnabled(self._current_step > 0)
        if self._current_step == 1:
            self._btn_next.setText(tr('完成'))
            self._btn_skip.hide()
        else:
            self._btn_next.setText(tr('下一步'))
            self._btn_skip.show()

        if animate and prev_idx != self._current_step and hasattr(self, '_cascade'):
            if self._current_step == 0:
                cards = list(self._lang_cards.values())
            else:
                cards = list(self._prov_cards.values())
            self._cascade.animate_targets(cards, start_opacity=0.15)

    def _go_next(self):
        if self._current_step < 1:
            # 记录当前步骤的选择
            self._collect_step_choice(self._current_step)
            self._current_step += 1
            # 第一步选择语言后，立即应用语言切换（让后续步骤显示对应语言）
            if self._current_step == 1 and self._lang_choice != get_language():
                set_language(self._lang_choice)
                self._retranslate()
            self._update_step()
        else:
            self._collect_step_choice(self._current_step)
            self._finish()

    def _go_back(self):
        if self._current_step > 0:
            self._current_step -= 1
            self._update_step()

    def _collect_step_choice(self, step):
        """收集当前步骤的选择"""
        if step == 0:
            for lang_code, card in self._lang_cards.items():
                if card.is_selected():
                    self._lang_choice = lang_code
                    break
        elif step == 1:
            for key, card in self._prov_cards.items():
                if card.is_selected():
                    self._provider_choice = key
                    break

    def _finish(self):
        """完成引导：保存所有选择到 config，然后触发应用重启

        重启原因：语言切换等需要全新进程才能确保所有 UI 文本完全重新加载，
        避免半刷新状态。
        """
        # 收集步骤选择（跳过/完成时）
        self._collect_step_choice(0)
        self._collect_step_choice(1)

        # 应用语言（如果还没应用）
        if self._lang_choice != get_language():
            set_language(self._lang_choice)

        # 保存翻译源
        config['translation_source'] = self._provider_choice

        # 标记完成
        config['first_run_completed'] = True
        save_config(config)

        self.completed.emit()
        # 关闭对话框，触发应用重启
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
        QApplication.exit(self.RESTART_EXIT_CODE)

```

"""Foxo 极简高端 UI 动效组件库（纯 QPainter 自绘 + 60fps 属性动画，零 Windows 透明残影）

视觉语言（Warm Porcelain & Soft Fox Ginger）：
  - 基底：温润暖瓷白 (#FFFFFF -> #FDFCFB -> #F6F3EF) + 暖石细描边 (#EAE6E1) + 柔和环境阴影
  - 主色：石墨深字 (#0F172A / #44403C) + 淡柔狐毛橙 (#DC7B45 / #E8925E / #B55E31)
  - 动效：所有按钮、切换器、滑块、卡片、导航与状态均由 QPropertyAnimation / QVariantAnimation 驱动
"""

import math

    QPropertyAnimation, QVariantAnimation, QEasingCurve,

UI_FONT_CANDIDATES = (
    'Noto Sans SC',
    'Source Han Sans SC',
    'Source Han Sans SC VF',
    'HarmonyOS Sans SC',
    'MiSans',
    'Alibaba PuHuiTi 3.0',
    'Sarasa UI SC',
    'LXGW WenKai',
    'PingFang SC',
    'Segoe UI',
)

MONO_FONT_CANDIDATES = (
    'Cascadia Mono',
    'JetBrains Mono',
    'Noto Sans Mono',
    'DejaVu Sans Mono',
    'Consolas',
)

_FONTS_INITIALIZED = False
_UI_FONT_FAMILY = 'Noto Sans SC'
_MONO_FONT_FAMILY = 'Consolas'


def init_ui_fonts():
    """加载内置免版权字体（assets/fonts）并解析最佳无版权纠纷字体家族"""
    global _FONTS_INITIALIZED, _UI_FONT_FAMILY, _MONO_FONT_FAMILY
    if _FONTS_INITIALIZED:
        return

    loaded_families = []
    try:
        from foxo.config import BUNDLE_DIR, APP_DIR
        font_dirs = [os.path.join(BUNDLE_DIR, 'assets', 'fonts')]
        app_fonts = os.path.join(APP_DIR, 'assets', 'fonts')
        if os.path.normcase(app_fonts) != os.path.normcase(font_dirs[0]):
            font_dirs.append(app_fonts)
        for fdir in font_dirs:
            if not os.path.isdir(fdir):
                continue
            for fname in sorted(os.listdir(fdir)):
                if fname.lower().endswith(('.ttf', '.otf', '.ttc')):
                    fid = QFontDatabase.addApplicationFont(os.path.join(fdir, fname))
                    if fid != -1:
                        for fam in QFontDatabase.applicationFontFamilies(fid):
                            if fam not in loaded_families:
                                loaded_families.append(fam)
    except Exception:
        pass

    available = set(QFontDatabase.families())
    resolved_ui = None
    for fam in loaded_families:
        if fam in available:
            resolved_ui = fam
            break
    if resolved_ui is None:
        for fam in UI_FONT_CANDIDATES:
            if fam in available:
                resolved_ui = fam
                break
    if resolved_ui:
        _UI_FONT_FAMILY = resolved_ui

    resolved_mono = None
    for fam in MONO_FONT_CANDIDATES:
        if fam in available:
            resolved_mono = fam
            break
    if resolved_mono:
        _MONO_FONT_FAMILY = resolved_mono

    _FONTS_INITIALIZED = True


def ui_font_family() -> str:
    if not _FONTS_INITIALIZED:
        init_ui_fonts()
    return _UI_FONT_FAMILY


def mono_font_family() -> str:
    if not _FONTS_INITIALIZED:
        init_ui_fonts()
    return _MONO_FONT_FAMILY


def ui_font_qss() -> str:
    primary = ui_font_family()
    ordered = [primary]
    for fam in UI_FONT_CANDIDATES:
        if fam not in ordered:
            ordered.append(fam)
    return ', '.join(f"'{fam}'" for fam in ordered[:6]) + ', sans-serif'


def ui_font(size: float = 10.0, weight=QFont.Medium) -> QFont:
    if weight == QFont.DemiBold:
        # Noto Sans SC 可变字体在 Windows 下缺省 600 字重，会退化为 Thin 极细体，统一归并到 Bold
        weight = QFont.Bold
    f = QFont(ui_font_family())
    f.setPointSizeF(float(size))
    f.setWeight(weight)
    f.setHintingPreference(QFont.PreferNoHinting)
    f.setStyleStrategy(QFont.PreferAntialias | QFont.NoSubpixelAntialias)
    return f


def mono_font(size: float = 9.0, weight=QFont.Bold) -> QFont:
    if weight == QFont.DemiBold:
        weight = QFont.Bold
    f = QFont(mono_font_family())
    f.setPointSizeF(float(size))
    f.setWeight(weight)
    f.setHintingPreference(QFont.PreferNoHinting)
    f.setStyleStrategy(QFont.PreferAntialias | QFont.NoSubpixelAntialias)
    return f

def build_light_palette() -> QPalette:
    """构建 Foxo 浅色主题调色板，避免 Windows 深色模式下 Fusion 回退到暗色文字/底色"""
    pal = QPalette()
    bg_window = QColor('#FAF8F5')
    bg_base = QColor('#FFFFFF')
    bg_alt = QColor('#F8F6F3')
    bg_btn = QColor('#F2EFEA')
    fg_text = QColor('#0F172A')
    fg_muted = QColor('#A8A29E')
    accent = QColor('#DC7B45')
    accent_dark = QColor('#B55E31')
    white = QColor('#FFFFFF')

    for group in (QPalette.ColorGroup.Active, QPalette.ColorGroup.Inactive):
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Window, bg_window)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText, fg_text)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Base, bg_base)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.AlternateBase, bg_alt)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.ToolTipBase, bg_base)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.ToolTipText, fg_text)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Text, fg_text)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.PlaceholderText, fg_muted)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Button, bg_btn)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText, fg_text)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.BrightText, white)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Light, white)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Midlight, bg_btn)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Mid, QColor('#DDD7D0'))
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Dark, fg_muted)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Shadow, QColor('#78716C'))
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, accent)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, white)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Link, accent)
        pal.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.LinkVisited, accent_dark)

    disabled = QPalette.ColorGroup.Disabled
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.Window, bg_window)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.WindowText, fg_muted)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.Base, bg_window)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.AlternateBase, bg_window)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.Text, fg_muted)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.PlaceholderText, fg_muted)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.Button, bg_btn)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.ButtonText, fg_muted)
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, QColor('#EAE6E1'))
    pal.setColor(disabled, QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, QColor('#78716C'))
    return pal


def apply_light_theme(app):
    """强制 Qt 应用使用浅色主题与调色板，并应用免版权全局默认字体"""
    init_ui_fonts()
    try:
        hints = app.styleHints()
        if hasattr(hints, 'setColorScheme') and hasattr(Qt, 'ColorScheme'):
            hints.setColorScheme(Qt.ColorScheme.Light)
    except Exception:
        pass
    app.setPalette(build_light_palette())
    app.setFont(ui_font(10.0, QFont.Medium))


def style_combobox_popup(combo: QComboBox):
    """强制下拉框弹出容器、列表视图与 viewport 使用不透明浅色样式

    规避两个 Qt6/Windows 渲染坑：
    1. 祖先窗口设置 `QWidget { background: transparent; }` 会级联到
       QComboBoxPrivateContainer 和 viewport，导致弹出框背景黑底/深灰底。
    2. 系统深色模式下，弹出容器默认沿用深色 QPalette，导致深色文字与深灰底重合。
    """
    view = combo.view()
    if view is None:
        return
    view.setAutoFillBackground(True)
    view.setStyleSheet(_COMBO_VIEW_QSS)
    viewport = view.viewport()
    if viewport is not None:
        viewport.setAutoFillBackground(True)
        viewport.setStyleSheet('background-color: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A;')
    container = view.parentWidget()
    if container is not None:
        container.setAutoFillBackground(True)
        container.setStyleSheet('QFrame { background-color: #FFFFFF; border: none; }')


class NoWheelSlider(QSlider):
    """防滚轮误触自绘高质感滑块（26px 完整高度，绝不裁切拇指与光晕）"""

    def __init__(self, orientation=Qt.Horizontal, parent=None):
        super().__init__(orientation, parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.ClickFocus)
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedHeight(26)
        self._hover_p = 0.0
        self._press_p = 0.0
        self._display_val = float(self.value())
        self._dragging = False

        self._anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'hoverProgress', self)
        self._anim.setDuration(160)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self._press_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'pressProgress', self)
        self._press_anim.setDuration(120)
        self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self._val_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'displayValue', self)
        self._val_anim.setDuration(135)
        self._val_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutQuart)

        self.valueChanged.connect(self._on_value_changed)

    def _get_hp(self):
        return self._hover_p

    def _set_hp(self, v):
        self._hover_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    hoverProgress = Property(float, _get_hp, _set_hp)

    def _get_pp(self):
        return self._press_p

    def _set_pp(self, v):
        self._press_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    pressProgress = Property(float, _get_pp, _set_pp)

    def _get_dv(self):
        return self._display_val

    def _set_dv(self, v):
        self._display_val = float(v)
        self.update()

    displayValue = Property(float, _get_dv, _set_dv)

    def _animate_press(self, target: float):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._press_anim.stop()
        self._press_anim.setDuration(profile.press_ms if target > 0.5 else profile.return_ms)
        self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(make_press_ease() if target > 0.5 else make_return_ease())
        self._press_anim.setStartValue(self._press_p)
        self._press_anim.setEndValue(target)
        self._press_anim.start()

    def _on_value_changed(self, val):
        target = float(val)
        if self._dragging or self.isSliderDown() or not self.isVisible() or is_headless_or_hidden(self):
            self._val_anim.stop()
            self._display_val = target
            self.update()
            return
        self._val_anim.stop()
        self._val_anim.setDuration(135)
        self._val_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._val_anim.setStartValue(self._display_val)
        self._val_anim.setEndValue(target)
        self._val_anim.start()

    def enterEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setDuration(profile.hover_ms)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._anim.start()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setDuration(profile.return_ms)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._anim.start()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def wheelEvent(self, event):
        event.ignore()

    def _pos_to_val(self, x: float) -> int:
        pad = 9.0
        span = max(1.0, self.width() - 2.0 * pad)
        ratio = max(0.0, min(1.0, (x - pad) / span))
        val = self.minimum() + ratio * (self.maximum() - self.minimum())
        step = max(1, self.singleStep())
        snapped = round((val - self.minimum()) / step) * step + self.minimum()
        return max(self.minimum(), min(self.maximum(), int(snapped)))

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton and self.isEnabled():
            self._dragging = False
            self.setSliderDown(True)
            self._animate_press(1.0)
            self.setValue(self._pos_to_val(event.position().x()))
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):
        if event.buttons() & Qt.LeftButton and self.isEnabled():
            self._dragging = True
            self.setValue(self._pos_to_val(event.position().x()))
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseMoveEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):
        if event.button() == Qt.LeftButton:
            self._dragging = False
            self.setSliderDown(False)
            self._animate_press(0.0)
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        w, h = self.width(), self.height()
        cy = h / 2.0
        pad = 9.0
        track_w = max(4.0, w - 2.0 * pad)
        span = max(1, self.maximum() - self.minimum())
        disp = max(float(self.minimum()), min(float(self.maximum()), self._display_val))
        ratio = max(0.0, min(1.0, (disp - self.minimum()) / float(span)))
        kx = pad + track_w * ratio

        # 底槽
        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
        p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor('#EAE6E1')))
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(pad, cy - 2.0, track_w, 4.0), 2.0, 2.0)

        # 柔狐橙进度条
        if kx > pad + 1.0:
            if self.isEnabled():
                lg = QLinearGradient(pad, 0, kx, 0)
                lg.setColorAt(0.0, QColor('#ED9E6E'))
                lg.setColorAt(1.0, QColor('#DC7B45'))
                p.setBrush(QBrush(lg))
            else:
                p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor('#F1C6A5')))
            p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(pad, cy - 2.0, kx - pad, 4.0), 2.0, 2.0)

        # 悬停/按下双层柔和光晕
        glow_p = max(self._hover_p, self._press_p)
        if glow_p > 0.02 and self.isEnabled():
            outer_r = 10.5 + 2.2 * self._press_p
            p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(220, 123, 69, int(22 * glow_p))))
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(kx, cy), outer_r, outer_r)
            p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(220, 123, 69, int(34 * glow_p))))
            p.drawEllipse(QPointF(kx, cy), 9.2 + 1.2 * self._press_p, 9.2 + 1.2 * self._press_p)

        # 拇指投影与纯白拇指
        thumb_r = 6.8 + 0.35 * self._hover_p + 0.85 * self._press_p
        p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(24, 20, 18, int(30 + 14 * self._press_p))))
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(kx, cy + 1.2), thumb_r, thumb_r)

        p.setBrush(QBrush(QColor('#FFFFFF')))
        ring_col = _lerp_color(QColor('#DC7B45'), QColor('#B55E31'), self._press_p)
        if not self.isEnabled():
            ring_col = QColor('#DDD7D0')
        p.setPen(QPen(ring_col, 2.2))
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(kx, cy), thumb_r - 1.1, thumb_r - 1.1)
        p.end()


class NoWheelComboBox(QComboBox):
    """防滚轮误触下拉框：滚轮滚动页面时不意外切换选项，右侧自绘旋转矢量下拉箭头"""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.ClickFocus)
        self._hover_p = 0.0
        self._popup_p = 0.0
        self._hover_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'hoverProgress', self)
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(150)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)
        self._popup_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'popupProgress', self)
        self._popup_anim.setDuration(170)
        self._popup_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutQuart)
        style_combobox_popup(self)

    def _get_hp(self):
        return self._hover_p

    def _set_hp(self, v):
        self._hover_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    hoverProgress = Property(float, _get_hp, _set_hp)

    def _get_pp(self):
        return self._popup_p

    def _set_pp(self, v):
        self._popup_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    popupProgress = Property(float, _get_pp, _set_pp)

    def _animate_popup_arrow(self, target: float):
        self._popup_anim.stop()
        self._popup_anim.setDuration(170 if target > 0.5 else 145)
        self._popup_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._popup_anim.setStartValue(self._popup_p)
        self._popup_anim.setEndValue(target)
        self._popup_anim.start()

    def enterEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._hover_anim.stop()
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(profile.hover_ms)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._hover_anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._hover_anim.setEndValue(1.0)
        self._hover_anim.start()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._hover_anim.stop()
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(profile.return_ms)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(make_ease_out())
        self._hover_anim.setStartValue(self._hover_p)
        self._hover_anim.setEndValue(0.0)
        self._hover_anim.start()
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def showPopup(self):
        style_combobox_popup(self)
        self._animate_popup_arrow(1.0)
        super().showPopup()
        view = self.view()
        if view is not None:
            popup_win = view.window()
            if popup_win is not None and popup_win is not self.window():
                animate_popup_fade_in(popup_win, 140)

    def hidePopup(self):
        super().hidePopup()
        self._animate_popup_arrow(0.0)

    def wheelEvent(self, event):
        event.ignore()

    def paintEvent(self, event):
        super().paintEvent(event)
        p = QPainter(self)
        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing, True)
        cx = self.width() - 14.0
        cy = self.height() / 2.0
        highlight = max(self._hover_p, 1.0 if self.hasFocus() else 0.0, self._popup_p)
        col = _lerp_color(QColor('#78716C'), QColor('#DC7B45'), highlight) if self.isEnabled() else QColor('#A8A29E')
        p.save()
        p.translate(cx, cy)
        p.rotate(180.0 * self._popup_p)
        p.setPen(QPen(col, 1.7, Qt.SolidLine, Qt.RoundCap, Qt.RoundJoin))
        p.setBrush(Qt.NoBrush)
        path = QPainterPath()
        path.moveTo(-4.0, -1.8)
        path.lineTo(0.0, 2.2)
        path.lineTo(4.0, -1.8)
        p.drawPath(path)
        p.restore()
        p.end()


def _lerp_color(c1: QColor, c2: QColor, t: float) -> QColor:
    t = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(t)))
    return QColor(
        int(c1.red() + (c2.red() - c1.red()) * t),
        int(c1.green() + (c2.green() - c1.green()) * t),
        int(c1.blue() + (c2.blue() - c1.blue()) * t),
        int(c1.alpha() + (c2.alpha() - c1.alpha()) * t),
    )


class AnimatedToggleSwitch(QAbstractButton):
    """极简胶囊拨动开关（苹果式拇指弹性拉伸 + 柔和外光环）"""

    def __init__(self, checked=False, accent='#DC7B45', parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._accent = QColor(accent)
        self._offset = 1.0 if checked else 0.0
        self._hover_p = 0.0
        self._press_p = 0.0

        self._anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'offset', self)
        self._anim.setDuration(210)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self._hover_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'hoverProgress', self)
        self._hover_anim.setDuration(150)
        self._hover_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self._press_anim = QPropertyAnimation(self, b'pressProgress', self)
        self._press_anim.setDuration(110)
        self._press_anim.setEasingCurve(QEasingCurve.OutCubic)

        self.setCheckable(True)
        self.setChecked(bool(checked))
        self.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
        self.setFixedSize(40, 22)

        self.toggled.connect(self._on_toggled)

    def _get_offset(self):
        return self._offset

    def _set_offset(self, v):
        self._offset = float(v)
        self.update()

    offset = Property(float, _get_offset, _set_offset)

    def _get_hp(self):
        return self._hover_p

    def _set_hp(self, v):
        self._hover_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    hoverProgress = Property(float, _get_hp, _set_hp)

    def _get_pp(self):
        return self._press_p

    def _set_pp(self, v):
        self._press_p = float(v)
        self.update()

    pressProgress = Property(float, _get_pp, _set_pp)

    def _on_toggled(self, checked):
        profile = current_motion_profile()
        self._anim.stop()
        self._anim.setDuration(profile.selection_ms)
        self._anim.setEasingCurve(make_spring_ease(0.75 if profile.uses_spring else 0.0))
        self._anim.setStartValue(self._offset)
        self._anim.setEndValue(1.0 if checked else 0.0)
        self._anim.start()

    def setChecked(self, checked):
        super().setChecked(bool(checked))
        if self._anim.state() != QPropertyAnimation.Running:
            self._offset = 1.0 if checked else 0.0
            self.update()
