class TestGlossaryAndAIBatch(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_glossary_exact_lookup(self):
        g = {'攻撃力': '攻击力', 'Inventory': '背包'}
        self.assertEqual(lookup_glossary_exact('攻撃力', glossary=g), '攻击力')
        self.assertEqual(lookup_glossary_exact('inventory', glossary=g), '背包')
        self.assertIsNone(lookup_glossary_exact('未收录', glossary=g))

    def test_deterministic_system_prompt(self):
        g1 = {'B': '乙', 'A': '甲'}
        g2 = {'A': '甲', 'B': '乙'}
        p1 = build_ai_system_prompt('ja', 'zh-CN', is_batch=True, glossary=g1)
        p2 = build_ai_system_prompt('ja', 'zh-CN', is_batch=True, glossary=g2)
        self.assertEqual(p1, p2)
        self.assertIn('- A => 甲', p1)
        self.assertIn('- B => 乙', p1)

    def test_parse_json_batch_response(self):
        raw = '```json\n{"0": "攻击力+15%", "1": "第一行\\n第二行"}\n```'
        parsed = _parse_batch_response(raw, 2)
        self.assertEqual(parsed, ['攻击力+15%', '第一行\n第二行'])

    def test_parse_numbered_fallback(self):
        raw = '1. 攻击力\n2. 防御力'
        parsed = _parse_batch_response(raw, 2)
        self.assertEqual(parsed, ['攻击力', '防御力'])

    def test_split_ai_batches_and_chunk_error_propagation(self):
        texts = [f'テキスト{i}' for i in range(15)]
        chunks = split_ai_batches(texts, max_items=12, max_chars=1600)
        self.assertEqual(len(chunks), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(chunks[0]), 12)
        self.assertEqual(len(chunks[1]), 3)

        mock_resp = MagicMock()
        mock_resp.status_code = 401
        mock_resp.json.return_value = {'error': {'message': 'Invalid API key'}}
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=mock_resp):
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                chunks[1], 'sys', api_key='bad', base_url='https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', model='m'
            )
            self.assertEqual(out, {})
            self.assertIn('HTTP 401', err)
            self.assertIn('Invalid API key', err)

        ok_resp = MagicMock()
        ok_resp.status_code = 200
        ok_resp.json.return_value = {
            'choices': [{'message': {'content': '{"0": "文本12", "1": "文本13", "2": "文本14"}'}}]
        }
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=ok_resp):
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                chunks[1], 'sys', api_key='sk-or-ok', base_url='https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', model='m'
            )
            self.assertEqual(err, '')
            self.assertEqual(out, {12: '文本12', 13: '文本13', 14: '文本14'})

    def test_translate_ai_chunk_sse_stream_ttft_and_400_fallback(self):
        """SSE 流式应按 UTF-8 正确拼接中文并记录 TTFT，流式报 400 时自动回退非流式"""
        sse_resp = MagicMock()
        sse_resp.status_code = 200
        sse_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        sse_resp.iter_lines.return_value = [
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe4\xb8\xad"}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\xe6\x96\x87\xe6\xb5\x8b\xe8\xaf\x95\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ]
        metrics = {}
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=sse_resp):
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, 'テスト')], 'sys', api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://amr-link.open-design.ai/v1', model='deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco',
                metrics_out=metrics,
            )
        self.assertEqual(err, '')
        self.assertEqual(out, {0: '中文测试'})
        self.assertIn('ttft_ms', metrics)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(metrics['ttft_ms'], 0)
        latest = get_last_ai_latency()
        self.assertEqual(latest.get('model'), 'deepseek-v4.1-flash-eco')
        self.assertIsNotNone(latest.get('ttft_ms'))

        # 流式被网关拒绝 (HTTP 400 stream unsupported) 时自动降级非流式
        bad_stream_resp = MagicMock()
        bad_stream_resp.status_code = 400
        bad_stream_resp.json.return_value = {'error': {'message': 'stream is not supported'}}
        fallback_ok_resp = MagicMock()
        fallback_ok_resp.status_code = 200
        fallback_ok_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'application/json'}
        fallback_ok_resp.json.return_value = {
            'choices': [{'message': {'content': '{"0": "非流式回退"}'}}]
        }
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', side_effect=[bad_stream_resp, fallback_ok_resp]) as mock_post:
            out2, err2 = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, 'テスト')], 'sys', api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://openrouter.ai/api/v1', model='m-fallback',
            )
        self.assertEqual(err2, '')
        self.assertEqual(out2, {0: '非流式回退'})
        self.assertEqual(mock_post.call_count, 2)
        self.assertNotIn('stream', mock_post.call_args_list[1].kwargs['json'])

    def test_translate_ai_chunk_streams_items_incrementally_before_done(self):
        """SSE 流式应按 JSON 键值对完成顺序在 [DONE] 前逐条回调 on_item"""
        import threading

        raw_lines = [
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"```json\\n{\\"0\\": \\"\xe4\xbd\xa0\xe5\xa5\xbd"}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\\\\\\"\xe4\xb8\x96\xe7\x95\x8c\\\\\\"\\", \\"1\\": \\"\xe7\xac\xac\xe4\xba\x8c"}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\xe6\x9d\xa1\\"}\\n```"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ]
        streamed_events = []
        done_seen_before_first_item = []

        def _line_gen():
            for idx_line, ln in enumerate(raw_lines):
                yield ln
                if idx_line == 1:
                    done_seen_before_first_item.append(('after_line_1', list(streamed_events)))

        sse_resp = MagicMock()
        sse_resp.status_code = 200
        sse_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        sse_resp.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: _line_gen()

        cancel_ev = threading.Event()
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=sse_resp):
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(10, '原文一'), (11, '原文二')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1',
                model='gpt-4o-mini',
                on_item=lambda orig_idx, val: streamed_events.append((orig_idx, val)),
                cancel_event=cancel_ev,
            )

        self.assertEqual(err, '')
        self.assertEqual(out, {10: '你好"世界"', 11: '第二条'})
        self.assertEqual(streamed_events, [(10, '你好"世界"'), (11, '第二条')])
        self.assertEqual(done_seen_before_first_item, [('after_line_1', [(10, '你好"世界"')])])

    def test_translate_ai_chunk_aborts_mid_stream_on_cancel_event(self):
        """cancel_event 置位后应立即中止 SSE 迭代并关闭 HTTP 连接"""
        import threading

        raw_lines = [
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe7\xac\xac\xe4\xb8\x80\xe6\x9d\xa1\\""}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":", \\"1\\": \\"\xe7\xac\xac\xe4\xba\x8c\xe6\x9d\xa1\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ]
        consumed = []
        cancel_ev = threading.Event()

        def _line_gen():
            for ln in raw_lines:
                consumed.append(ln)
                yield ln

        sse_resp = MagicMock()
        sse_resp.status_code = 200
        sse_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        sse_resp.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: _line_gen()

        def _on_item(_idx, _val):
            cancel_ev.set()

        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=sse_resp):
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, '原文一'), (1, '原文二')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1',
                model='gpt-4o-mini',
                on_item=_on_item,
                cancel_event=cancel_ev,
            )

        self.assertEqual(out, {})
        self.assertEqual(err, '')
        self.assertEqual(len(consumed), 1)
        sse_resp.close.assert_called()


class TestMyMemoryEmail(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_is_valid_email(self):
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_email('user@example.com'))
        self.assertTrue(is_valid_email('  foo.bar+1@sub.domain.org  '))
        self.assertFalse(is_valid_email(''))
        self.assertFalse(is_valid_email('invalid'))
        self.assertFalse(is_valid_email('user@localhost'))
        self.assertFalse(is_valid_email('user @example.com'))

    @patch('foxo.translation._session.get')
    def test_mymemory_uses_config_email(self, mock_get):
        mock_resp = MagicMock()
        mock_resp.json.return_value = {
            'responseStatus': 200,
            'quotaFinished': False,
            'responseData': {'translatedText': '魔法攻击力提升'},
        }
        mock_get.return_value = mock_resp

        orig_mm = config.get('mymemory')
        try:
            config['mymemory'] = {'email': '  player@example.com  '}
            res = translate_mymemory('魔法攻撃力上昇', src='ja', dest='zh-CN')
            self.assertEqual(res, '魔法攻击力提升')
            params = mock_get.call_args.kwargs['params']
            self.assertEqual(params.get('de'), 'player@example.com')

            config['mymemory'] = {'email': 'not-an-email'}
            translate_mymemory('魔法攻撃力上昇', src='ja', dest='zh-CN')
            params_invalid = mock_get.call_args.kwargs['params']
            self.assertNotIn('de', params_invalid)

            config['mymemory'] = {'email': ''}
            translate_mymemory('魔法攻撃力上昇', src='ja', dest='zh-CN')
            params_empty = mock_get.call_args.kwargs['params']
            self.assertNotIn('de', params_empty)
        finally:
            config['mymemory'] = orig_mm if orig_mm is not None else {'email': ''}

    @patch('foxo.translation._session.get')
    def test_mymemory_quota_warning_returns_none(self, mock_get):
        mock_resp = MagicMock()
        mock_resp.json.return_value = {
            'responseStatus': 429,
            'quotaFinished': True,
            'responseData': {
                'translatedText': 'MYMEMORY WARNING: YOU USED ALL AVAILABLE FREE TRANSLATIONS FOR TODAY.'
            },
        }
        mock_get.return_value = mock_resp
        self.assertIsNone(translate_mymemory('テスト', src='ja', dest='zh-CN', email=''))

class TestTokenSpeedMetrics(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_estimate_token_count_and_compute_speed(self):
        self.assertEqual(estimate_token_count(''), 0)
        self.assertEqual(estimate_token_count('   \n '), 0)
        self.assertEqual(estimate_token_count('中文测试'), 4)
        self.assertEqual(estimate_token_count('abcd1234'), 2)

        # 流式扣除首字延迟：21 tokens, ttft=500ms, total=1000ms -> (21 - 1) / 0.5s = 40.0 tok/s
        self.assertEqual(compute_token_speed(21, 500, 1000, is_stream=True), 40.0)
        # 解码区间过短 (<20ms) 时退化为按总耗时估算
        self.assertEqual(compute_token_speed(10, 495, 500, is_stream=True), 20.0)
        # 非流式按总耗时计算
        self.assertEqual(compute_token_speed(10, 500, 500, is_stream=False), 20.0)
        self.assertEqual(compute_token_speed(0, 100, 200, is_stream=True), 0.0)

    def test_translate_ai_chunk_usage_tokens_per_sec_and_stream_options_fallback(self):
        import time as _t

        def _timed_lines(lines):
            for ln in lines:
                _t.sleep(0.015)
                yield ln

        # 1) 带 usage 尾包与实时首字回调
        sse_with_usage = MagicMock()
        sse_with_usage.status_code = 200
        sse_with_usage.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        sse_with_usage.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: _timed_lines([
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe9\xad\x94\xe6\xb3\x95"}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\xe6\x94\xbb\xe5\x87\xbb\xe5\x8a\x9b\xe6\x8f\x90\xe5\x8d\x87\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: {"choices":[],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":50,"completion_tokens":24}}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ])
        metrics = {}
        first_tokens = []
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=sse_with_usage) as mock_post:
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, '魔法攻撃力が上昇')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1',
                model='gpt-4o-mini',
                metrics_out=metrics,
                include_usage=True,
                on_first_token=lambda ms: first_tokens.append(ms),
            )
        self.assertEqual(err, '')
        self.assertEqual(out, {0: '魔法攻击力提升'})
        self.assertEqual(len(first_tokens), 1)
        self.assertEqual(mock_post.call_args.kwargs['json'].get('stream_options'), {'include_usage': True})
        self.assertEqual(metrics.get('output_tokens'), 24)
        self.assertFalse(metrics.get('tokens_estimated'))
        self.assertTrue(metrics.get('is_stream'))
        self.assertGreater(metrics.get('tokens_per_sec', 0.0), 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(get_last_ai_latency().get('tokens_per_sec'), metrics.get('tokens_per_sec'))

        # 2) 不带 usage 时自动估算 Token 数
        sse_no_usage = MagicMock()
        sse_no_usage.status_code = 200
        sse_no_usage.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        sse_no_usage.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: _timed_lines([
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe6\x94\xbb\xe5\x87\xbb\xe5\x8a\x9b\xe6\x8f\x90\xe5\x8d\x87\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ])
        metrics_est = {}
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', return_value=sse_no_usage):
            out_est, err_est = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, '攻撃力上昇')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1',
                model='gpt-4o-mini',
                metrics_out=metrics_est,
                include_usage=True,
            )
        self.assertEqual(err_est, '')
        self.assertEqual(out_est, {0: '攻击力提升'})
        self.assertTrue(metrics_est.get('tokens_estimated'))
        self.assertGreater(metrics_est.get('output_tokens', 0), 0)
        self.assertGreater(metrics_est.get('tokens_per_sec', 0.0), 0.0)

        # 3) 兼容网关拒绝 stream_options 返回 HTTP 400 时自动去掉该字段重试
        bad_opt_resp = MagicMock()
        bad_opt_resp.status_code = 400
        bad_opt_resp.json.return_value = {'error': {'message': 'Unknown parameter: stream_options'}}
        ok_retry_resp = MagicMock()
        ok_retry_resp.status_code = 200
        ok_retry_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        ok_retry_resp.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: iter([
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe9\x87\x8d\xe8\xaf\x95\xe6\x88\x90\xe5\x8a\x9f\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ])
        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', side_effect=[bad_opt_resp, ok_retry_resp]) as mock_post2:
            out_retry, err_retry = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, 'テスト')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.openai.com/v1',
                model='gpt-4o-mini',
                include_usage=True,
            )
        self.assertEqual(err_retry, '')
        self.assertEqual(out_retry, {0: '重试成功'})
        self.assertEqual(mock_post2.call_count, 2)
        self.assertNotIn('stream_options', mock_post2.call_args_list[1].kwargs['json'])
        self.assertIs(mock_post2.call_args_list[1].kwargs['json'].get('stream'), True)


class TestAiTurboConcurrencyAndWarmup(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pool_capacities_expanded_for_high_concurrency(self):
        self.assertGreaterEqual(_adapter._pool_maxsize, 32)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(translate_pool._max_workers, 24)

    def test_plan_ai_chunks_turbo_and_legacy(self):
        self.assertEqual(plan_ai_chunks([]), [])

        short_texts = ['攻撃力', '防御力', '体力', '魔力', '速度']
        chunks_turbo = plan_ai_chunks(short_texts, turbo_mode=True, turbo_chunk_size=2)
        self.assertEqual([len(c) for c in chunks_turbo], [2, 2, 1])
        self.assertEqual(
            [idx for ch in chunks_turbo for idx, _ in ch],
            [0, 1, 2, 3, 4],
        )

        chunks_single = plan_ai_chunks(short_texts[:4], turbo_mode=True, turbo_chunk_size=1)
        self.assertEqual(len(chunks_single), 4)

        long_mid = 'あ' * 50
        long_max = 'い' * 80
        mixed = ['短い', long_mid, 'も一つ', long_max, 'ボタン']
        chunks_mixed = plan_ai_chunks(mixed, turbo_mode=True, turbo_chunk_size=2, long_text_len=45)
        self.assertEqual(chunks_mixed[0], [(3, long_max)])
        self.assertEqual(chunks_mixed[1], [(1, long_mid)])
        self.assertEqual(chunks_mixed[2], [(0, '短い'), (2, 'も一つ')])
        self.assertEqual(chunks_mixed[3], [(4, 'ボタン')])

        # 非极速模式保持老分片契约
        legacy_small = plan_ai_chunks(short_texts, turbo_mode=False, max_items=12)
        self.assertEqual(len(legacy_small), 1)
        legacy_large = plan_ai_chunks([f'文{i}' for i in range(12)], turbo_mode=False, max_items=12)
        self.assertEqual([len(c) for c in legacy_large], [6, 6])

    def test_translate_ai_chunk_429_jittered_retry_and_cancel_abort(self):
        import threading

        rate_resp = MagicMock()
        rate_resp.status_code = 429
        ok_resp = MagicMock()
        ok_resp.status_code = 200
        ok_resp.headers = {'content-type': 'text/event-stream; charset=utf-8'}
        ok_resp.iter_lines.side_effect = lambda decode_unicode=False: iter([
            b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"0\\": \\"\xe9\x99\x90\xe6\xb5\x81\xe6\x81\xa2\xe5\xa4\x8d\\"}"}}]}',
            b'data: [DONE]',
        ])

        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', side_effect=[rate_resp, ok_resp]) as mock_post, \
             patch('foxo.translation.time.sleep') as mock_sleep:
            out, err = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, 'テスト')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.deepseek.com/v1',
                model='deepseek-flash',
            )
        self.assertEqual(err, '')
        self.assertEqual(out, {0: '限流恢复'})
        self.assertEqual(mock_post.call_count, 2)
        self.assertEqual(mock_sleep.call_count, 1)

        cancel_ev = threading.Event()
        rate_resp2 = MagicMock()
        rate_resp2.status_code = 429

        def _post_then_cancel(*_a, **_kw):
            cancel_ev.set()
            return rate_resp2

        with patch('foxo.translation._session.post', side_effect=_post_then_cancel) as mock_post2:
            out2, err2 = translate_ai_chunk(
                [(0, 'テスト')],
                'sys',
                api_key='sk-ok',
                base_url='https://api.deepseek.com/v1',
                model='deepseek-flash',
                cancel_event=cancel_ev,
            )
        self.assertEqual(out2, {})
        self.assertEqual(err2, '')
        self.assertEqual(mock_post2.call_count, 1)

    def test_warmup_ai_connection_skips_local_and_warms_remote(self):
        import time as _t
        from foxo import translation as tr_mod

        with tr_mod._warmup_lock:
            tr_mod._warmed_origins.clear()

        with patch('foxo.translation._session.head') as mock_head:
            warmup_ai_connection('')
            warmup_ai_connection('http://localhost:11434/v1')
            warmup_ai_connection('http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1')
            _t.sleep(0.05)
            self.assertEqual(mock_head.call_count, 0)

            warmup_ai_connection('https://api.deepseek.com/v1')
            for _ in range(30):
                if mock_head.call_count >= 1:
                    break
                _t.sleep(0.01)
            self.assertEqual(mock_head.call_count, 1)
            self.assertEqual(mock_head.call_args.args[0], 'https://api.deepseek.com/')
            # 60 秒内重复预热应去重
            warmup_ai_connection('https://api.deepseek.com/v1')
            _t.sleep(0.03)
            self.assertEqual(mock_head.call_count, 1)

class _FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, status_code=200, json_data=None, text='', chunks=None, headers=None):
        self.status_code = status_code
        self._json_data = json_data
        self.text = text
        self._chunks = chunks or []
        self.headers = headers or {}
        self.closed = False

    def json(self):
        if isinstance(self._json_data, Exception):
            raise self._json_data
        if self._json_data is None:
            raise ValueError('Not JSON')
        return self._json_data

    def iter_content(self, chunk_size=65536):
        for chunk in self._chunks:
            yield chunk

    def close(self):
        self.closed = True


class _FakeSession:
    def __init__(self, routes):
        self._routes = routes
        self.calls = []

    def get(self, url, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append((url, kwargs))
        handler = self._routes.get(url)
        if handler is None:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected URL: {url}')
        if callable(handler):
            return handler(url, **kwargs)
        if isinstance(handler, Exception):
            raise handler
        return handler


class TestUpdaterLogic(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_and_compare_versions(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_version('v1.2.3'), ((1, 2, 3), 1, ''))
        self.assertEqual(parse_version('V2.0.0-beta.1'), ((2, 0, 0), 0, 'beta.1'))
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version('v1.0.1', '1.0.0'))
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version('1.1.0', '1.0.9'))
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version('1.0.0', '1.0.0-beta.2'))
        self.assertTrue(is_newer_version('1.0.0-beta.10', '1.0.0-beta.2'))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version('v1.0.0', '1.0.0'))
        self.assertFalse(is_newer_version('0.9.9', '1.0.0'))

    def test_normalize_repo_and_url(self):
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo(''), '')
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo('invalid'), '')
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo('https://gitlab.com/a/b'), '')
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo('owner/Foxo'), 'owner/Foxo')
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo('https://github.com/owner/Foxo.git/'), 'owner/Foxo')
        self.assertEqual(normalize_repo('github.com/owner/Foxo'), 'owner/Foxo')
        self.assertEqual(get_github_repo_url(''), '')
        self.assertEqual(get_github_repo_url('owner/Foxo'), 'https://github.com/owner/Foxo')

    def test_build_mirror_url_and_select_asset(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            build_mirror_url('https://gh-proxy.com', 'https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/Foxo.exe'),
            'https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/Foxo.exe',
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            build_mirror_url(
                'https://gh-proxy.com/',
                'https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/Foxo.exe',
            ),
            'https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/a/b/releases/download/v1/Foxo.exe',
        )
        assets = [
            {'name': 'Foxo.exe.sha256', 'browser_download_url': 'https://example.com/sha'},
            {'name': 'source.zip', 'browser_download_url': 'https://example.com/src.zip'},
            {'name': 'Foxo-1.1.0-win64.exe', 'browser_download_url': 'https://example.com/Foxo.exe'},
        ]
        selected = select_release_asset(assets)
        self.assertIsNotNone(selected)
        self.assertEqual(selected['name'], 'Foxo-1.1.0-win64.exe')

    def test_check_for_updates_unconfigured_does_not_call_network(self):
        session = _FakeSession({})
        info = check_for_updates(current_version='1.0.0', repo='', session=session)
        self.assertEqual(info.status, 'unconfigured')
        self.assertEqual(info.current_version, '1.0.0')
        self.assertFalse(info.has_update)
        self.assertEqual(info.release_notes, get_local_release_notes())
        self.assertEqual(session.calls, [])

    def test_check_for_updates_github_official_success(self):
        api_url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/testuser/Foxo/releases/latest'
        payload = {
            'tag_name': 'v1.2.0',
            'name': 'Foxo v1.2.0',
            'body': '新增自动更新功能与公告展示',
            'published_at': '2026-11-26T10:00:00Z',
            'html_url': 'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases/tag/v1.2.0',
            'assets': [
                {
                    'name': 'Foxo.exe',
                    'browser_download_url': 'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases/download/v1.2.0/Foxo.exe',
                    'size': 102400,
                }
            ],
        }
        session = _FakeSession({api_url: _FakeResponse(200, json_data=payload)})
        info = check_for_updates(
            current_version='1.0.0',
            repo='testuser/Foxo',
            mirrors=('https://mirror.example/',),
            session=session,
        )
        self.assertEqual(info.status, 'update_available')
        self.assertTrue(info.has_update)
        self.assertEqual(info.latest_version, '1.2.0')
        self.assertEqual(info.source_type, 'github')
        self.assertEqual(info.source_label, 'GitHub 官方源')
        self.assertEqual(info.release_notes, '新增自动更新功能与公告展示')
        self.assertEqual(info.asset_name, 'Foxo.exe')
        self.assertEqual(len(session.calls), 1)

    def test_check_for_updates_fallback_to_mirror_json_then_atom(self):
        api_url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/testuser/Foxo/releases/latest'
        atom_url = 'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases.atom'
        m1 = 'https://m1.example/'
        m2 = 'https://m2.example/'

        # Case 1: 官方失败 -> m1 JSON 成功
        payload = {
            'tag_name': 'v1.0.0',
            'name': 'Foxo v1.0.0',
            'body': '当前稳定版本',
            'published_at': '2026-11-26T00:00:00Z',
            'assets': [],
        }
        session_json = _FakeSession({
            api_url: ConnectionError('timeout'),
            build_mirror_url(m1, api_url): _FakeResponse(200, json_data=payload),
        })
        info1 = check_for_updates(
            current_version='1.0.0',
            repo='testuser/Foxo',
            mirrors=(m1, m2),
            session=session_json,
        )
        self.assertEqual(info1.status, 'up_to_date')
        self.assertFalse(info1.has_update)
        self.assertEqual(info1.source_type, 'mirror')
        self.assertIn('m1.example', info1.source_label)
        self.assertEqual(info1.mirror_prefix, m1)

        # Case 2: 官方失败 -> m1 API 返回 HTML -> 回退 m1 releases.atom
        atom_xml = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
        <feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
          <entry>
            <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/1/v1.3.0</id>
            <updated>2026-11-27T08:30:00Z</updated>
            <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases/tag/v1.3.0"/>
            <title>Foxo v1.3.0</title>
            <content type="html">&lt;p&gt;优化识别速度&lt;/p&gt;</content>
          </entry>
        </feed>'''
        session_atom = _FakeSession({
            api_url: ConnectionError('blocked'),
            build_mirror_url(m1, api_url): _FakeResponse(200, text='<html>blocked</html>'),
            build_mirror_url(m1, atom_url): _FakeResponse(200, text=atom_xml),
        })
        info2 = check_for_updates(
            current_version='1.0.0',
            repo='testuser/Foxo',
            mirrors=(m1,),
            session=session_atom,
        )
        self.assertEqual(info2.status, 'update_available')
        self.assertTrue(info2.has_update)
        self.assertEqual(info2.latest_version, '1.3.0')
        self.assertEqual(info2.release_notes, '优化识别速度')
        self.assertEqual(info2.source_type, 'mirror')
        self.assertEqual(
            info2.asset_url,
            'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases/download/v1.3.0/Foxo.exe',
        )

    def test_check_for_updates_all_failed_returns_error(self):
        api_url = 'https://api.github.com/repos/testuser/Foxo/releases/latest'
        atom_url = 'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases.atom'
        m1 = 'https://m1.example/'

        })

            current_version='1.0.0',
            repo='testuser/Foxo',
            mirrors=(m1,),
            session=session,
        )
        self.assertEqual(info.status, 'error')
        self.assertTrue(bool(info.error))
        self.assertEqual(info.release_notes, get_local_release_notes())

    def test_download_update_asset_fallback_validation_and_cancel(self):
        raw_url = 'https://github.com/testuser/Foxo/releases/download/v1.1.0/Foxo.exe'
        m1 = 'https://m1.example/'
        m2 = 'https://m2.example/'
        valid_pe = b'MZ' + b'\x00' * 128

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            # 直连返回伪造 HTML 错误页 + m1 404 -> 回退 m2 成功
            session = _FakeSession({
                raw_url: _FakeResponse(
                    200,
                    chunks=[b'<html>not an exe</html>'],
                    headers={'Content-Length': '23'},
                ),
                build_mirror_url(m1, raw_url): _FakeResponse(404),
                build_mirror_url(m2, raw_url): _FakeResponse(
                    200,
                    chunks=[valid_pe[:64], valid_pe[64:]],
                    headers={'Content-Length': str(len(valid_pe))},
                ),
            })
            progress_events = []
            path, src = download_update_asset(
                raw_url,
                tmpdir,
                asset_name='Foxo.exe',
                mirrors=(m1, m2),
                progress_cb=lambda d, t, s: progress_events.append((d, t, s)),
                session=session,
            )
            self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(path))
            self.assertIn('m2.example', src)
            self.assertEqual(progress_events[-1][0], len(valid_pe))
            self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(path + '.part'))

            # 取消下载立即中断
            cancel_evt = threading.Event()
            cancel_evt.set()
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as ctx:
                download_update_asset(
                    raw_url,
                    tmpdir,
                    asset_name='Foxo.exe',
                    mirrors=(m1,),
                    cancel_event=cancel_evt,
                    session=session,
                )
            self.assertIn('取消', str(ctx.exception))

    def test_prepare_windows_exe_update_exe_and_zip(self):
        valid_pe = b'MZ' + b'\x90' * 64
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
            target_exe = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'Foxo.exe')
            with open(target_exe, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(b'MZ' + b'\x01' * 16)

            # 1) 直接 .exe
            dl_exe = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'dl.exe')
            with open(dl_exe, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(valid_pe)
            stage_1 = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'stage1')
            bat_path, staged_exe = prepare_windows_exe_update(
                dl_exe,
                target_exe=target_exe,
                pid=99999,
                staging_dir=stage_1,
            )
            self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(bat_path))
            self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(staged_exe))
            with open(bat_path, 'rb') as f:
                raw_bat = f.read()
            self.assertIn(b'\r\n', raw_bat)
            self.assertNotIn(b'chcp 65001', raw_bat)
            self.assertIn(b'TARGET_PID=99999', raw_bat)

            # 2) .zip 解压提取 Foxo.exe
            dl_zip = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'Foxo-1.1.0.zip')
            buf = io.BytesIO()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, 'w') as zf:
                zf.writestr('Foxo/README.txt', 'notes')
                zf.writestr('Foxo/Foxo.exe', valid_pe)
            with open(dl_zip, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(buf.getvalue())
            stage_2 = os.path.join(tmpdir, 'stage2')
            bat2, staged2 = prepare_windows_exe_update(
                dl_zip,
                target_exe=target_exe,
                pid=88888,
                staging_dir=stage_2,
            )
            self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(bat2))
            with open(staged2, 'rb') as f:
                self.assertEqual(f.read(), valid_pe)


class TestAboutTabAndI18n(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
        self._orig_mode = config.get('settings_mode', 'simple')
        self._orig_auto = config.get('auto_check_update', True)

    def tearDown(self):
        config['settings_mode'] = self._orig_mode
        config['auto_check_update'] = self._orig_auto

    def test_about_tab_ui_author_link_and_update_states(self):
        from foxo.ui.settings_window import SettingsPanel, SettingsWindow

        self.assertIn('auto_check_update', DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        panel = None
        try:
            with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.save_config'):
                panel = SettingsPanel(logo_icon=QIcon())
                self.assertIn('about', panel._nav_buttons)

                panel._switch_tab('about')
                self.app.processEvents()
                self.assertEqual(panel.tab_title.text(), tr('关于'))

                w = panel._about_widgets
                label_texts = [lbl.text() for lbl in panel._content_frame.findChildren(QLabel)]
                self.assertTrue(any(AUTHOR_NAME in t for t in label_texts))
                self.assertTrue(any(f'v{__version__}' in t for t in label_texts))
                self.assertFalse(w['auto_update_btn'].isEnabled())
                self.assertIn(__version__, w['notes_ver_lbl'].text())
                self.assertEqual(w['notes_lbl'].text(), get_local_release_notes())

                # 作者 B 站主页跳转
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.QDesktopServices.openUrl') as mock_open:
                    w['author_btn'].click()
                mock_open.assert_called_once()
                opened_url = mock_open.call_args[0][0]
                self.assertEqual(opened_url, QUrl(AUTHOR_BILIBILI_URL))

                # 未配置 GitHub 仓库时点击检查更新：友好提示且不发起网络请求
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.get_github_repo', return_value=''), \
                     patch('foxo.ui.settings_window._show_message_box', return_value=QMessageBox.Ok) as mock_box:
                    w['check_btn'].click()
                self.assertEqual(mock_box.call_count, 1)
                self.assertEqual(panel._update_info.status, 'unconfigured')

                # 模拟检测到新版本：更新公告、启用自动更新按钮
                fake_info = UpdateInfo(
                    status='update_available',
                    current_version=__version__,
                    latest_version='1.5.0',
                    has_update=True,
                    release_title='Foxo v1.5.0',
                    release_notes='新增热更新公告测试内容',
                    published_at='2026-11-28T12:00:00Z',
                    release_url='https://github.com/demo/Foxo/releases/tag/v1.5.0',
                    asset_name='Foxo.exe',
                    asset_url='https://github.com/demo/Foxo/releases/download/v1.5.0/Foxo.exe',
                    source_type='mirror',
                    source_label='镜像源 (gh-proxy.com)',
                    mirror_prefix='https://gh-proxy.com/',
                )
                panel._on_update_checked(fake_info, manual=True)
                self.app.processEvents()
                self.assertTrue(w['auto_update_btn'].isEnabled())
                self.assertEqual(w['notes_lbl'].text(), '新增热更新公告测试内容')
                self.assertIn('1.5.0', w['notes_ver_lbl'].text())
                self.assertIn('镜像源', w['status_lbl'].text())
        finally:
            if panel is not None:
                panel.close()

        # 验证 SettingsWindow 在简约与专业模式下打开关于页均不被纵向挤压
        win = None
        try:
            with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.GlobalHotkeyManager.register_defaults'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.SettingsWindow._preload_ocr'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.QSystemTrayIcon.show'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.translate_pool.shutdown'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.save_config'):
                win = SettingsWindow()
                win.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen, True)
                win.show()
                win.resize(*win._settings_size)
                win.settings_panel.setGeometry(win._panel_rect_for_size(win.width(), win.height()))
                win.settings_panel.show()
                for mode in ('simple', 'pro'):
                    win.settings_panel.set_settings_mode(mode, animate=False)
                    win.settings_panel._switch_tab('about')
                    self.app.processEvents()
                    cf = win.settings_panel._content_frame
                    self.assertGreaterEqual(
                        cf.height(),
                        cf.minimumSizeHint().height(),
                        f'About tab crushed in {mode} mode',
                    )
        finally:
            if win is not None:
                win.close()

    def test_auto_check_update_and_apply_flow(self):
        from foxo.ui.settings_window import SettingsPanel, SettingsWindow

        panel = None
        try:
            with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.save_config'):
                panel = SettingsPanel(logo_icon=QIcon())
                panel._update_info = UpdateInfo(
                    status='update_available',
                    current_version=__version__,
                    latest_version='1.6.0',
                    has_update=True,
                    asset_name='Foxo.exe',
                    asset_url='https://github.com/demo/Foxo/releases/download/v1.6.0/Foxo.exe',
                    source_type='github',
                    source_label='GitHub 官方源',
                )
                # 源码模式下载完成后提示路径，不触发替换脚本
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.IS_FROZEN', False), \
                     patch('foxo.ui.settings_window._show_message_box', return_value=QMessageBox.Ok) as mock_box:
                    panel._on_update_downloaded('C:/tmp/Foxo.exe', 'GitHub 官方源')
                self.assertEqual(mock_box.call_count, 1)

                # 打包模式下载完成且用户确认后，生成批处理并发射 update_install_requested
                emitted = []
                panel.update_install_requested.connect(emitted.append)
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.IS_FROZEN', True), \
                     patch('foxo.ui.settings_window._show_message_box', return_value=QMessageBox.Yes), \
                     patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.prepare_windows_exe_update', return_value=('C:/tmp/apply.bat', 'C:/tmp/Foxo_new.exe')) as mock_prep:
                    panel._on_update_downloaded('C:/tmp/Foxo.exe', 'GitHub 官方源')
                mock_prep.assert_called_once_with('C:/tmp/Foxo.exe')
                self.assertEqual(emitted, ['C:/tmp/apply.bat'])
        finally:
            if panel is not None:
                panel.close()

        win = None
        try:
            with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.GlobalHotkeyManager.register_defaults'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.SettingsWindow._preload_ocr'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.QSystemTrayIcon.show'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.translate_pool.shutdown'), \
                 patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.save_config'):
                win = SettingsWindow()
                win.setAttribute(Qt.WA_DontShowOnScreen, True)
                # 未配置仓库时自动检查更新直接跳过，不触发网络或线程
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.get_github_repo', return_value=''), \
                     patch.object(win.settings_panel, 'start_update_check') as mock_chk:
                    win._maybe_auto_check_update()
                mock_chk.assert_not_called()

                # 配置仓库后自动检查更新触发静默检查
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.get_github_repo', return_value='demo/Foxo'), \
                     patch.object(win.settings_panel, 'start_update_check') as mock_chk:
                    win._maybe_auto_check_update()
                mock_chk.assert_called_once_with(manual=False)

                # 应用更新启动脚本并退出
                with patch('foxo.ui.settings_window.launch_update_script') as mock_launch, \
                     patch.object(win, 'close') as mock_close, \
                     patch('PySide6.QtWidgets.QApplication.quit') as mock_quit:
                    win._on_apply_update_and_quit('C:/tmp/apply_update.bat')
                mock_launch.assert_called_once_with('C:/tmp/apply_update.bat')
                mock_close.assert_called_once()
                mock_quit.assert_called_once()
        finally:
            if win is not None:
                win.close()

    def test_about_i18n_keys_have_english_translations(self):
        orig_lang = get_language()
        keys = [
            '关于',
            '版本信息、作者主页与自动检查更新',
            '当前版本',
            '作者',
            '哔哩哔哩个人空间',
            '访问作者主页',
            'GitHub 仓库',
            '打开仓库',
            '暂未创建（敬请期待）',
            'GitHub 页面暂未创建',
            '检查更新与自动更新',
            '默认优先使用 GitHub 官方源检测更新，网络异常时自动切换镜像源。',
            '启动时自动检查更新',
            'GitHub 检查更新',
            '立即自动更新',
            '取消下载',
            '更新公告',
            '发现新版本',
            '已是最新',
            '检测失败',
            '更新已就绪',
            '自动更新失败',
        ]
        try:
            with patch('foxo.config.save_config'):
                set_language('en')
                for k in keys:
                    self.assertNotEqual(tr(k), k, f'Missing English translation for: {k}')
        finally:
            with patch('foxo.config.save_config'):
                set_language(orig_lang)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
